🚧 We’re Hiring: PMO Manager \| Building Construction 🚧
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced PMO Manager to join our growing construction team in the UAE. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in project management, contract administration, cost control, authority coordination, and construction planning for high\-rise and building construction projects.
 



  





 📍 Location: UAE
 



 🕒 Job Type: Full\-time
 



 💰 Salary: AED 30,000 per month
 



  





 🔹 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Lead and manage PMO operations across multiple building construction projects
 



 • Formalize, review, and manage construction contracts and project documentation
 



 • Review and approve project specifications, contract terms, and technical requirements
 



 • Prepare and review BOQs, project budgets, and cost estimates
 



 • Identify and resolve building design and project identity gaps during planning and execution stages
 



 • Coordinate and manage communication with government authorities, consultants, and stakeholders
 



 • Monitor project timelines, milestones, deliverables, and construction schedules
 



 • Prepare project execution plans and ensure timely project delivery
 



 • Monitor cost\-to\-complete analysis, project cash flow, and financial performance
 



 • Implement effective cost control measures and risk management strategies
 



 • Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulations, and authority requirements
 



 • Coordinate with project managers, consultants, procurement, and engineering teams for smooth project execution
 



 • Generate project progress reports and provide strategic recommendations to management
 



  





 🔹 Requirements:
 



 • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field
 



 • Proven experience as PMO Manager in building construction projects within the UAE
 



 • Strong knowledge of contracts, BOQ preparation, cost control, and project planning
 



 • Experience dealing with consultants, authorities, and project stakeholders
 



 • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
 



 • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively
 



 • PMP certification is an advantage
 



  





  





 📩 Apply Now: Career@abualnaga.com
 



  




* 📌 Subject Line: PMO Manager Application

**General Description** 




 Join a leading project delivery and consulting environment supporting large\-scale asset management and capital project initiatives across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We are looking for experienced Asset Management Project Managers with strong expertise in asset lifecycle management, governance, and delivery within asset\-intensive industries.
 



  





 This opportunity is ideal for senior project management professionals who can operate at the intersection of capital project delivery and long\-term asset performance, ensuring assets are properly governed, documented, commissioned, and transitioned into operations.
 



  





 The role requires strong stakeholder management, structured project governance, and deep understanding of asset management frameworks such as ISO 55000 within complex enterprise or infrastructure environments.
 



  





 This is a contract / freelance engagement (initial 6 months) supporting ongoing regional transformation and infrastructure programs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of asset management projects from initiation through commissioning and operational handover
* Manage project scope, schedule, cost, risks, issues, and stakeholder alignment across the full delivery lifecycle
* Develop and maintain asset registers, asset data standards, and governance frameworks for asset information management
* Implement asset lifecycle and maintenance strategies aligned with ISO 55000 and recognized asset management practices
* Coordinate closely with engineering, operations, maintenance, and client stakeholders to ensure delivery and operational objectives remain aligned
* Drive governance activities including status reporting, steering committee updates, change management, and escalation management
* Oversee commissioning and handover processes, ensuring complete documentation, asset readiness, and clear operational ownership
* Track project benefits, delivery performance, and operational outcomes against agreed objectives and KPIs
* Apply structured PMO and project delivery methodologies consistently throughout the engagement



  





**Required Experience** 



* Minimum 15\+ years of project management experience within asset\-intensive industries such as infrastructure, utilities, energy, transportation, industrial, or large\-scale facilities environments
* Strong experience delivering asset management or capital project initiatives within the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider GCC region
* Hands\-on knowledge of asset management standards and frameworks, particularly ISO 55000
* Proven experience managing project governance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and operational handover activities
* Experience building and managing asset registers, maintenance strategies, and lifecycle management processes
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior client leadership and PMO stakeholders
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is highly preferred
* IAM or other asset management certifications are considered an advantage
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or related discipline
* Arabic language skills are advantageous but not mandatory
* Immediate or short\-notice availability is highly preferred



  





**Work Setup** 




 • Contract / Freelance engagement
 



 • Initial 6\-month contract
 



 • Onsite

**Company Description**
  

**Work with Us. Change the World.**
  

 At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
   

  

 There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
   

  

 We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
   

  

**Job Description**
  

 The Director of Commercial Management will provide strategic and operational leadership across an operating unit, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality services and driving commercial success.
   

  

 This role is pivotal in shaping and executing the company’s strategic vision, overseeing project delivery, financial performance, client engagement, and talent development.
   

  

**Key Requirements**
* Contribute to and execute the company’s strategic direction, aligning operational goals with broader business objectives.
* Influence and communicate strategic priorities across the business to ensure alignment and buy\-in.
* Anticipate market trends and adapt business strategies to maintain competitive advantage and profitability.
* Establish operational objectives and work plans; delegate responsibilities to subordinate managers and teams.
* Oversee project delivery throughout the construction lifecycle, ensuring technical excellence, financial control, and client satisfaction.
* Ensure compliance with internal quality assurance (QA) standards and policies, and in accordance with internal project delivery governance.
* Develop and manage financial plans for the regional business unit.
* Accountable for full P\&L performance, driving profitability and sustainable growth.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of future work to support long\-term business objectives.
* Lead engagement with key clients, focusing on both new opportunities and existing relationships of strategic importance.
* Present project deliverables and benchmark data to clients, ensuring transparency and value delivery.
* Foster a high\-performance culture through effective talent management, including identifying and developing key talent.
* Promote collaboration across regional and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead by example in promoting innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Strong financial acumen with a track record of managing P\&L and delivering profitable growth.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and multidisciplinary teams.
  


**Qualifications**
* A minimum of 20 years post\-undergraduate experience.
* Minimum of Bachelor of Science in Quantity Surveying and/or Engineering (or equivalent) from an accredited, internationally recognized institution or University.
* MRICS or equivalent accreditation.
  


**Additional Information**
  

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* 
***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***
  

**About AECOM**
  

 AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.
   

  

 AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.
   

  

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**
  

 You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community \- where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

**Job Overview
 
 :** 




 The Projects Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and successful delivery of all projects within the organization. The role oversees the full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Projects Director operates as the senior authority across all project teams, aligning engineering, procurement, commercial, and site operations with the company’s business objectives and premium construction standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




 Strategic Leadership \& Portfolio Management
 


* Lead and oversee the entire project portfolio from inception to final handover.
* Define project governance structures, reporting frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
* Align project execution strategy with corporate financial and operational objectives.
* Review and approve master schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.
* Establish project performance KPIs, including cost variance, schedule variance, productivity, and margin.



 Project Execution \& Operational Excellence
 


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations and company standards.
* Monitor progress across multiple projects and intervene proactively to resolve bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, commercial, and site teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in construction methodologies and resource utilization.
* Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and quality benchmarks.



 Financial \& Commercial Management
 


* Oversee project budgeting, forecasting, and cost control mechanisms.
* Review and approve major variations, subcontractor agreements, and commercial negotiations.
* Safeguard project profitability, cash flow, and margin performance.
* Monitor procurement efficiency and material cost optimization.
* Ensure proper contract administration and claims management practices.



 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, safety standards, and contractual requirements.
* Implement enterprise\-level risk mitigation strategies across all active projects.
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture with zero\-incident objectives.
* Ensure implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems across sites.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the executive representative for clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and resolution of concerns.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution.
* Support succession planning and capability development within the project's function.



 Personal Attributes:
 


* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to manage a diverse team and maintain project momentum.
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Results\-driven with a high accountability and ownership mindset.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality on\-site.



  





**Requirements
 
 :** 



* A minimum of 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in construction project management, with a proven track record working with reputable contracting companies in the UAE.
* Proven experience in managing luxury projects,
 **including high\-end villas** 
 , with a strong understanding of premium construction standards and finishes.
* Demonstrated success in leading multi\-project portfolios within the UAE or GCC region.



  





**Qualification
 
 :** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field from a recognized university.
* Master’s Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, etc.) preferred.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.
* Commercial Operations \& Infrastructure
* Lead implementation and optimization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud).
* Establish standardized commercial processes, reporting dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.
* Oversee commercial excellence initiatives including:
* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.
* Benchmark best practices from leading oncology players (MNCs).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for Glenmark.
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to distributor\-led markets and early access programs.
* Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.
* Time\-to\-market reduction in non\-core geographies.
* CRM implementation effectiveness and adoption rates.
* Achievement of early access program targets.
* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.


**Key Relationships/Stakeholders**
**External**
* Oncology KOLs and treatment centers
* Oncology societies and networks
* Strategic partners and service providers


**Internal (other Than Direct Reports)**
* Regional/Country Commercial Leadership Teams
* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of Complex Change is accountable for the hands‑on execution and successful delivery of RAKBANK’s most complex, cross‑functional, and strategically critical transformation programmes. The role owns end‑to‑end delivery outcomes—time, scope, and budget—across multi‑platform, multi‑vendor, and multi‑year initiatives with board‑level visibility and CBUAE scrutiny. Acting as the bank’s delivery field commander, the incumbent manages complexity, controls scope, and drives proactive risk mitigation. The role serves as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and offshore delivery teams, ensuring execution quality and accountability. It requires deep, proven experience in leading large‑scale banking transformations to measurable outcomes.
 



  





  





**What You will Do** 



* Own executive delivery accountability for RAKBANK’s most complex transformation programmes across core banking, digital, payments, and infrastructure.
* Ensure programmes are delivered to committed scope, timelines, and budgets with clear, outcome‑based ownership.
* Lead proactive risk identification and mitigation through deep upfront assessments and a live, senior‑reviewed RAID framework.
* Enforce rigorous scope management and prevent scope creep via disciplined change control and executive escalation.
* Act as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and vendors, ensuring contractual accountability and milestone delivery.
* Lead and align Offshore Development Centres and offshore delivery teams to programme plans, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Design and mobilise complex, multi‑year programme structures, governance forums, and inter‑workstream dependencies.
* Chair programme steering and governance forums, resolving blockers and escalating issues to CTO, ExCo, and CEO as required.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk engagement for programmes under CBUAE scrutiny.
* Produce board‑quality, risk‑adjusted programme reporting and build delivery leadership capability across programme managers and change leads.



  





**What You Will Brin** 



* 20\+ years of progressive technology and transformation leadership, with a minimum of 5 years in an EVP, MD, Programme Director, or CXO\-adjacent delivery leadership role within a bank or globally regulated financial institution.
* Demonstrated track record of personally leading and successfully completing multi\-year, cross\-platform transformation programmes in banking — specifically including core banking migration or major platform upgrade, payments modernisation, or digital platform transformation.
* Expert\-level command of upfront risk management, scope control, and delivery governance in complex, multi\-vendor programme environments — with evidence of having prevented or resolved scope creep and delivery crises in prior engagement.
* Proven experience managing Tier\-1 vendor relationships and ODC/offshore delivery partnerships within programme scope — holding external parties to contractual accountability and delivery standard.
* Expert command of enterprise programme governance frameworks (MSP, PMI\-PgMP, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt these pragmatically to the pace and constraints of live banking transformation.
* Experience engaging with central bank regulators (CBUAE, FCA, MAS, or equivalent) on technology change submissions and supervisory engagement, in partnership with governance and compliance function.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA, MSP Practitioner, or PMI\-PgMP certification highly preferred.



  





**What We are Not Looking for:** 




 ❌ A coordinator or status‑reporting PMO profile that tracks plans but does not personally own delivery outcomes, risk decisions, and executive accountability.
 



 ❌ A leader who reacts to issues after escalation, rather than proactively identifying, structuring, and mitigating complex delivery risks upfront.
 



 ❌ A purely theoretical transformation expert with “exposure” to large programmes, but without proven, hands‑on experience delivering multi‑platform banking transformations under board and regulatory scrutiny.

 Experience in Vertical Transportation (elevators/escalators) or related MEP disciplines is highly valued. Familiarity with reading and managing lift/escalator design drawings and specifications.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
   

  

 Moove’s growth has been fuelled by its global Uber partnership and support of leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, MUFG, and many others. With operations now spanning 19 cities across 6 continents \- Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and the Middle East \- Moove continues to expand its offerings through strategic acquisitions and partnerships with industry leaders, including Waymo and Uber. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. The role also leads key strategic initiatives, including new market launches, new business lines (e.g. AV), and other growth opportunities, ensuring disciplined execution from planning through implementation.
   

  

**This role is a "temp role" of 6 months.**

data.jd_text:
**Remobile Group is looking for a Group Operations Manager to help oversee and control daily operations across our growing businesses and teams.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised, structured, proactive, and experienced in e\-commerce operations. The right person will work closely with the CEO and team members across different locations to make sure tasks are clearly assigned, deadlines are followed, communication stays organised, and operational issues are reported before they become bigger problems.
 



  





 This is not only an admin role. We are looking for someone who can bring structure, accountability, and follow\-up across multiple teams, offices, and online business operations.
 



  





 About Remobile Group
 



 Remobile Group operates multiple businesses in the mobile phone and consumer electronics industry, including e\-commerce operations, Shopify stores, refurbishment, procurement, sales, marketing, and international teams.
 



  





 The Group Operations Manager will help create one clear operating structure across the company so that all important tasks, projects, and responsibilities are properly tracked and followed up.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 You will be responsible for keeping control of daily tasks and operational follow\-up across Remobile Group. You will make sure tasks are created correctly in ClickUp or Notion, assigned to the right person, given clear deadlines, and followed up until completion.
 



  





 You will also monitor team communication through Slack, ensure important discussions are converted into clear tasks, and keep the CEO updated on progress, delays, bottlenecks, and issues that require attention.
 



  





 The role includes coordinating with employees across different departments and locations, including Pakistan, Dubai, and European operations, while being based hybrid in the Netherlands, Germany, or Poland.
 



  





 You will help prepare daily and weekly operational updates, track overdue tasks, follow up with team members, support meeting preparation, take meeting notes, and make sure every meeting ends with clear action points.
 



  





 You will also support e\-commerce operations by helping teams stay organised around Shopify\-related tasks, product updates, marketing follow\-ups, customer experience issues, stock/pricing coordination, reporting, and general online business execution.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience in e\-commerce operations, operations coordination, project coordination, or business operations.
 



  





 You should have practical experience using ClickUp or Notion for task management and be comfortable using Slack for team communication. You must be able to create structure, follow up professionally, and keep teams accountable without creating unnecessary pressure or confusion.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organised, reliable, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working directly with senior management. You should be able to understand priorities, follow up on deadlines, identify delays, and clearly report what is completed, what is pending, and what needs CEO attention.**

* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.

**About Valtech**
 At Valtech, we are reshaping the way brands connect with their customers. As a global digital innovation company, we fuse creativity, technology, and strategy to solve complex business challenges and deliver exceptional experiences.
   

  

 With over 6,500 experts in 60\+ offices across 20\+ countries, we are expanding our footprint in MENA with Dubai as the strategic hub. At Valtech we thrive on driving business transformation as trusted partners to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are part of Valtech MENA, the experience innovation company, combining the uncommon to unlock a better way for people to experience the world. We work at the intersection of disciplines, cultures, and perspectives to create solutions that go beyond expectations, helping brands move ahead and lead in a digital world.
   

  

 We value clarity, collaboration, and a strong respect for craft. That mindset shapes both what we create and how we work together.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are looking for an Experience Operations Lead to take ownership of how experience design is delivered across projects.
   

  

 This role focuses on turning strong experience direction into high quality, well structured delivery. You will ensure that ideas hold up through the realities of timelines, tools, team dynamics, and technical constraints, without losing clarity or intent.
   

  

 You will define how delivery works, support teams in executing it, and ensure a consistent standard across all work.
   

  

**The role**
 You are responsible for making sure that experience design is delivered properly, consistently, and at a high level of quality.
   

  

 You work from a clear experience direction and help shape how it is delivered in practice. You are not solely responsible for defining the vision, but you contribute to how it evolves through real delivery.
   

  

 You create clarity where there is complexity and structure where there is ambiguity. You care about craft and about the systems that allow that craft to scale.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Delivery and execution**
* Own the delivery of experience design work across projects and clients
* Translate experience direction into clear and actionable plans
* Ensure UX, UI, motion, and content outputs are consistent and high quality
* Make decisions to maintain quality under real constraints
* Protect the integrity of the experience through handover to engineering


**Delivery strategy and standards**
* Define how experience design is delivered across projects and programs
* Establish clear standards for workflows, documentation, and quality
* Work closely with leadership to shape delivery approaches
* Balance quality, speed, and feasibility in day to day work


**Design operations and workflow**
* Establish scalable ways of working across teams and projects
* Improve collaboration between design, product, and engineering
* Define and apply documentation standards that teams can follow
* Support delivery across geographies and with external partners
* Create clarity in how work moves from concept to execution


**Team support and production**
* Support designers in their day to day work
* Manage resourcing, timelines, and coordination
* Remove blockers so teams can focus on design
* Help maintain consistency and quality across the team


**AI and operational improvement**
* Explore how AI and tools can improve workflows and delivery
* Identify opportunities to automate and simplify work
* Support the team in adopting new tools in a practical way
* Continuously improve how the team works


**How You Work With Others**
 You work from clear experience direction while collaborating closely with design, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You are the point of authority for experience delivery within projects. You guide teams and stakeholders toward decisions that support both quality and feasibility.
   

  

 You work closely with the Head of Experience and other leads, contributing to how the department evolves while owning delivery within your scope.

**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview** 




 The Senior Projects Manager is responsible for leading and delivering multiple infrastructure projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. The role involves strategic planning, technical leadership, and coordination across multidisciplinary teams, particularly in water and wastewater infrastructure projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Leadership \& Execution** 



* Direct and manage all ongoing projects from mobilization through to final handover.
* Ensure project delivery within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Develop and implement overall project execution strategies and construction methodologies.
* Plan and allocate resources effectively across all project sites.



  





**Management** 



* Lead and supervise Project Managers, Engineers, Planning, QA/QC, Safety, and Procurement teams.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and ensure productivity targets are met.
* Develop manpower planning and recruitment strategies based on project needs.



  





**Planning \& Monitoring** 



* Review and approve construction schedules, method statements, risk assessments, and technical submissions.
* Monitor project progress, critical path activities, and recovery plans to prevent delays.
* Conduct regular project review meetings to assess performance and implement corrective actions.



  





**Contract \& Commercial Management** 



* Review and interpret contracts, BOQs, specifications, and drawings, including FIDIC conditions.
* Manage project budgets, cash flow forecasts, cost reports, and profitability margins.
* Participate in tender reviews, pricing strategies, and risk analysis.



  





**Risk \& Compliance** 



* Identify technical, financial, and contractual risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with UAE authority regulations, project specifications, and international standards.
* Maintain strict adherence to QA/QC systems and approved Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs).



  





**Procurement \& Coordination** 



* Oversee procurement planning, subcontractor selection, and material approvals.
* Monitor material requirements and procurement activities across all sites.
* Coordinate with structural, mechanical, electrical, and ICA teams for effective interface management.



  





**Health, Safety \& Quality** 



* Ensure implementation of HSE policies and promote a zero\-incident culture.
* Monitor quality control processes to ensure compliance with project standards.



  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, and government authorities.
* Represent the company in high\-level meetings and negotiations.



  





**Project Close\-Out \& Reporting** 



* Ensure smooth project close\-out, including testing, commissioning, documentation, and final accounts.
* Develop and improve internal systems for reporting, cost control, and performance monitoring.



  





**Strategic Contribution** 



* Support senior management in business development, expansion initiatives, and strategic planning.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering.
* Minimum
 **15 years of experience** 
 in the UAE/GCC, specifically in Water Treatment, Hydro plants and wastewater infrastructure projects.
* Proven experience in:
* Pumping stations and treatment plants
* Water\-retaining structures
* Underground structures, shoring, and dewatering
* Strong knowledge of UAE authority standards and regulations.
* Proficiency in:
* AutoCAD
* MS Office
* MS Project / Primavera
* Ability to manage multidisciplinary projects.
* Valid UAE driving license.
* Strong technical, leadership, and project management skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (Arabic is an advantage).

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

 Education

 Leadership Experience

* Leadership and Team Management: Proven ability to lead and motivate teams, manage conflicts, and ensure project objectives are met.

Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:

* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.

* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.

data.jd_text:
**About Edenred**
 Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.
   

  

 Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.
   

  

 Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi\-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.
   

  

 True to the Group's purpose, "Enrich connections. For good.", these solutions enhance users' well\-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.
   

  

 Edenred’s 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
   

  

 In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
   

  

 Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.
   

  

**THE UAE CONTEXT**
 Edenred UAE is a fast growing payroll service provider serving more than 15,000 business and more than 2\.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions. We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll and for employees to receive their salaries and use it in the simplest way offering multiple value added services via our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge and card services)
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 The MLRO is primarily responsible for managing the identification, investigation, and reporting of suspicious activities related to money laundering and financial crime. This role leads the preparation and submission of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs/STRs) to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and submit reports and AdHoc regulatory reports, conducts thorough investigations of flagged transactions, and supports the Risk Manager in conducting regular AML risk assessments. The MLRO serves as the main liaison with regulatory authorities on AML matters, supports policy maintenance, and provides senior management and the Board with clear reporting on AML program effectiveness. Additionally, the MLRO collaborates with the broader compliance team to ensure strong internal controls and supports AML training initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR/STR): Receiving, investigating, and reporting suspicious internal transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and relevant regulators in a timely and accurate manner.
* Investigation Management: Conduct thorough investigations into flagged transactions or activities, documenting findings and determining appropriate next steps.
* Risk Assessment: Support the Risk Manager by contributing to regular, organization\-wide AML risk assessments to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities to financial crime.
* Regulatory Liaison: Act as the main point of contact for regulatory authorities regarding AML matters, managing inquiries, providing required documentation, and supporting audits.
* Policy and Procedure Maintenance: Maintain and update AML policies, procedures, and internal controls to reflect current laws, regulations, and evolving risks.
* Reporting to Board: Provide clear and regular reports on the effectiveness of the AML program, suspicious activity trends, and risk assessments to senior management and the Board.
* Training Support: Assist in delivering AML training and awareness initiatives related to suspicious activity identification and reporting.
* Collaborate closely with the Compliance Lead, Director, and other stakeholders to support overall compliance and risk mitigation strategies.


 AML Tools and Systems Familiarity:
   

  

* Transaction Monitoring Systems (e.g., NICE Actimize, FICO TONBELLER, Oracle Mantas, SAS AML)
* Sanctions Screening Tools (e.g., World\-Check, Dow Jones Risk \& Compliance, LexisNexis Bridger Insight)
* Customer Due Diligence (CDD)/KYC Platforms (e.g., ComplyAdvantage, IdentityMind, Onfido, Trulioo)
* Case Management Systems (e.g., AML RightSource, CaseWare, Actimize AML Case Manager)
* Regulatory Reporting Tools integrated with FIUs or regulatory portals
* Experience with data analysis and business intelligence tools such as SQL, Tableau, or Power BI is a plus.


**YOUR PROFILE**
* Minimum of 5 PQE
* Proven AML experience, particularly in SAR/STR reporting and investigations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of AML regulations, FIU reporting requirements, and financial crime typologies.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills with attention to detail.
* CAMS Certified
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.


**REPORTING STRUCTURE:**
 The selected candidate will report directly to CLCO and Board of Directors.
   

  

**COLLABORATION:**
 The candidate will collaborate with Compliance Director, Risk Manager, legal, audit teams, and business units in charge of processes.

**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
   

  

 We combine on\-the\-ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role in Brief**
 The Manager \- Client Service \& Global Program will manage the Client Services and Program Department, maintaining a high level of service quality, understanding client needs, and developing strong client relationships, while ensuring compliance with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT. This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.
   

  

 The purpose of QIMA’s Client Service \& Program team is to deliver seamless certification experience to our clients by managing key programs and ensuring the highest standards of client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Supervise the Program Management \& Client Service Team and ensure continuous monitoring of service quality and operational efficiency.
* Manage and maintain client relationships to enhance the customer service experience, ensuring service quality and efficient operations.
* Identify and seek further business opportunities while developing relationships with new clients.
* Oversee client’s programs and maintain understanding of regulatory program requirements including SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT.
* Support the Sales Team to resolve client enquiries and problems with consistency and accuracy.
* Handle ad\-hoc assignments as required.
* Champion an AI\-first mindset by promoting the use of AI tools and technologies in day\-to\-day operations and encouraging experimentation and adoption of AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and elevate service quality.


**Qualifications**
**To succeed in this role, you have:**
* Diploma or degree holder in any discipline; Electrical, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering background is a plus.
* Fluent in written and spoken English; Chinese or Arabic speaking is an advantage and preferable.
* 5\+ years of working experience in operations and client service within a certification body; experience in testing laboratory management and in\-depth technical knowledge are an advantage.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in managing a team, customer service, and client management.
* Self\-initiated, independent, and a good team player.
* 5\+ years of total experience; experience in certification bodies with team management responsibilities is highly valued.
* Familiarity with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT is a strong advantage.
* A genuine enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and its practical applications in operations, quality control, or client management; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and decision\-making is a strong plus.


**Additional Information**
 Because our differences make the difference, at QIMA we are proud to promote inclusive diversity and equal opportunities! Our policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
   

  

*QIMA recognizes and recruits all its talents.*

**Job Purpose:** 




 The role of Conference Manager focuses on creating and delivering multiple high\-quality, industry\-relevant conference and workshop programs. Key responsibilities include developing strategic content, managing speaker relationships, overseeing advisory boards, and driving partnerships with government, international, local partners, and associations. * Managing and developing direct reports

* Business experience in the Middle East

* Excellent networking and information\-gathering abilities
* Engaging, professional, and diplomatic demeanor
* Strong teamwork skills to ensure the efficient running of the event team across content, marketing, sales, and operations.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team

 environment.

 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.

* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.

**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.

* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future.
