data.jd_text:
**Introduction To Role**
 The International region is AstraZeneca’s largest, most diverse and fastest\-growing region, representing around one\-third of total company revenue. Spanning more than 90 countries across five continents, it covers over 70% of the world’s population. International is not “Rest of World” — it is “Most of World” — and with that scale comes a profound responsibility to patients, as the burden of non\-communicable disease and mortality is disproportionately high across our markets. International is a critical growth engine for AstraZeneca, delivering double\-digit growth across all therapy areas and playing a central role in the company’s future success. We operate in a complex, rapidly evolving environment — and we are doubling down on growth and pipeline delivery to make Ambition 2030 a reality in International. At the heart of this is how we use AI, digital and data to transform our company, accelerate our science and maximize our impact for patients.
 *Ready to influence how a major global business runs its future?*
 We are looking for a dynamic individual to fulfil the role of
 **Senior Director, Digital \& AI for Analytics and Process Transformation, International** 
 . The successful candidate will be accountable for re\-wiring critical process to simplify and accelerate through AI and automation, starting with key performance analytics and annual business cycle processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be capable of navigating a senior leadership environment, securing progress with minimal direction, and showcasing proactive initiative. Moreover, Senior Director Digital \& AI for Analytics and Process Transformation will bring domain expertise in Data, Insight and Analytics including performance analytics, data strategy, and data visualization with a strong understanding of business fundamentals.
   

  

 Excellent cross functional leadership experience as well as an extensive knowledge of drug development and commercialization is crucial. Demonstrably strong skills in the areas of strategic thinking, decision making, communication, enterprise leadership, problem solving, influence without authority.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 Digital \& AI for
 **Analytics and Process Transformation**
* Automation and Process redesign: Identify and automate high\-friction workflows, applying AI automation to remove bottlenecks, reduce cycle times and manual effort while improving quality and compliance
* Annual business cycle transformation: Embed AI to simplify and automate planning, forecasting, and performance reviews
* Analytics modernization: Rewire key performance analytics (commercial, medical, market access) with standardized datasets, highly visual dashboards, and AI\-enabled automation and analytics to accelerate decision\-making, acting as voice into global GIBEX, EAI, AXIAL programs
* AI \& digital fluency: Define and execute the upskilling agenda for International — building AI literacy, data fluency, and digital ways\-of\-working across functions
* Enterprise alignment: Partner with Global GIBEX, EAI, AXIAL and other enterprise programs to ensure International priorities are represented, while partnering to adapt global capabilities to local market realities


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Subject\-matter expertise in Sales and Marketing, AI, Digital and Innovation
* Experience in Data, Insight and Analytics including Forecasting and Performance Analytics
* Understanding of the dynamic external environment including new innovative digital technology
* Highly developed communication and influencing abilities across organizational teams and levels in a large and matrixed operating environment
* Ability to express sophisticated ideas in a clear and compelling way to multiple external and internal partner groups
* Proven business partnering skills across multiple stakeholder groups
* Proven project management skills in matrix organizations
* An excellent communicator; ability to simplify complex messages into clear, visual stories and messages for executive presentations
* Experience of working with Senior Management Teams with good understanding of decision\-making dynamics
* Evidence of the ability to pull together diverse teams over whom they have no line management responsibility
* Experience of successful influencing cross functionally, cross\-culturally and cross\-TA
* Evidence of strong independence and innovative seeker of strategic solutions; a strongly conceptual thinker
* Curiosity and capability to understand and support business need from different business areas
* Pragmatism and can\-do attitude


*AstraZeneca offers the chance to shape the future of healthcare at scale, combining scientific strength with real\-world impact across diverse markets; work happens in an open, collaborative community where people learn from each other, stretch beyond their comfort zone and see a clear link between their efforts and better outcomes for patients, supported by leaders who value curiosity, sustainability and continuous development. If this role sparks your ambition to transform how data, AI and digital power impact for patients across the world, apply now to join the journey!*
**Date Posted**
 12\-May\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 31\-May\-2026
   

  

 AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry\-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non\-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

We are hiring for a role of Manager – Marketing \& Home Delivery with a leading Food and Beverage company
 



 Location Dubai
 



**A. Marketing \& Brand Management** 




 Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with business objectives across markets. • Ensure consistent brand positioning, visual identity, and communication across all channels and geographies. • Lead campaign planning and execution across offline and digital channels to drive traffic, dine\-in sales, brand awareness, and delivery revenue. • Drive new product launches, seasonal campaigns, value promotions, and brand collaborations in partnership with operations and external agencies. • Manage the digital marketing ecosystem, including social media, paid media, SEO/SEM, influencer activity, content planning, email marketing, and website updates where applicable. • Oversee content strategy and brand storytelling to ensure relevance, consistency, and strong consumer engagement. • Monitor campaign ROI, reach, engagement, acquisition, and conversion metrics, and continuously optimize spends and channel mix. • Work closely with operations and finance teams to ensure marketing initiatives translate into measurable revenue growth and profitable outcomes. • Track competitive activity, customer trends, pricing moves, and market insights to refine strategy and identify growth opportunities.
 



**B. Home Delivery Strategy \& Operations** 




 Own end\-to\-end delivery performance across all participating brands and markets. • Drive delivery revenue growth, order volumes, channel profitability, and customer retention. • Manage and optimize relationships with aggregators and delivery partners across markets, including day to\-day issue resolution and escalation management. • Lead commercial negotiations on commissions, visibility, campaigns, service levels, promotional mechanics, and contractual terms. • Optimize menu engineering, pricing architecture, combos, offers, imagery, and merchandising to improve conversion and ticket size on delivery platforms. • Monitor and improve key delivery KPIs such as SLA adherence, preparation and dispatch delays, order accuracy, cancellation rates, refund trends, complaints, and platform ratings.
 



**C. Data Analytics, MIS \& Performance Management** 
 • Build and manage robust MIS and reporting frameworks across marketing and delivery operations. • Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly performance data to derive actionable insights by brand, outlet, platform, market, and campaign. • Track campaign effectiveness, aggregator performance, customer behavior, menu performance, discount efficiency, and profitability trends. • Drive real\-time decision\-making through dashboards, performance reviews, variance analysis, and commercial diagnostics. • Identify opportunities for revenue optimization, cost control, productivity improvement, and process efficiency. • Present insights, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership in a concise and business\-focused manner.
 



**D. Customer Experience \& Continuous Improvement** 
 • Monitor customer feedback, ratings, reviews, and complaint patterns across all relevant channels and platforms. • Partner with operations teams to improve end\-to\-end guest experience in delivery and brand touchpoints. • Drive service recovery improvements and root\-cause analysis for recurring issues. • Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on data, customer feedback, and market learning to strengthen service consistency across brands and geographies.
 



**E. Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Management** 
 • Collaborate closely with operations, finance, supply chain, culinary, IT, and brand teams to ensure coordinated execution. • Align marketing and delivery initiatives with business priorities, outlet capabilities, and budget parameters. • Work with regional and market teams to maintain consistency while adapting execution to local consumer preferences and platform dynamics. • Support internal reviews, business planning cycles, and leadership updates with reliable data and practical recommendations. • Build and manage robust MIS and reporting frameworks across marketing and delivery operations. • Analyze daily, weekly, and monthly performance data to derive actionable insights by brand, outlet, platform, market, and campaign. • Track campaign effectiveness, aggregator performance, customer behavior, menu performance, discount efficiency, and profitability trends. • Drive real\-time decision\-making through dashboards, performance reviews, variance analysis, and commercial diagnostics. • Identify opportunities for revenue optimization, cost control, productivity improvement, and process efficiency. • Present insights, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership in a concise and business\-focused manner.

 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Drive Technical Excellence:** 
 Lead major technical initiatives, ensuring architectural soundness, scalability, and long\-term impact.
* **Own Delivery:** 
 Oversee full project lifecycles from design to deployment with a focus on speed, quality, and reliability.
* **Release Management:** 
 Run a predictable release process with progressive delivery, clear rollout and rollback strategies, and strong operational readiness.
* **Platform Ownership:** 
 Own the AWS and Kubernetes platform end\-to\-end, including reliability, security, performance, and cost.
* **Hands\-On Execution:** 
 Stay close to the work by writing code, reviewing PRs, debugging production issues, and improving core services when needed.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Design, standardize, and maintain Terraform\-managed environments and operational best practices.
* **CI/CD and Velocity:** 
 Own CI/CD pipelines, improve build and deploy reliability, reduce lead time, and remove friction from the developer workflow.
* **Observability and Reliability:** 
 Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and SLO\-driven reliability practices.
* **On\-Call Leadership:** 
 Build and manage on\-call rotations, incident response, escalation paths, and postmortems with clear follow\-ups.
* **Technical Standards:** 
 Set and enforce engineering standards for architecture, code quality, security, and operational discipline.
* **Team Leadership:** 
 Mentor and develop engineers, create ownership, and keep priorities clear and execution under control.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Partner with Product and other stakeholders to align platform work with business goals and delivery commitments.



**Qualifications** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Director of Platform Engineering with the qualifications below. Each requirement is mandatory for this role:
 


* **Software Engineering Background:** 
 8\+ years building and operating production web applications and systems.
* **Platform Engineering Background:** 
 5\+ years owning AWS and Kubernetes in production, including reliability, security, and cost control.
* **Hands\-On Leadership:** 
 Regularly designs, implements, debugs, and reviews code and infrastructure, and can execute independently when needed.
* **Startup Mindset:** 
 Thrives in fast\-moving startups, takes ownership, works hard when needed, and brings high energy with a bias for action.
* **Infrastructure as Code Experience:**

* **Delivery and Releases:** 
 Owns CI/CD pipelines, release processes, progressive rollouts, and rollback strategies to keep deployments fast and safe.
* **Observability Stack:**

* **On\-Call Operations:**

* **Execution Focus:**

* **Communication Skills:**

* **English Fluency:** 
 Fluent in spoken and written English for high\-stakes technical discussions.
* **Relocation Readiness:** 
 Based in Bangkok or willing to relocate and work in a multicultural team.



**Working with Manatal** 



* This role is based at our Bangkok office in the heart of the city center
* As a team of diverse cultures and nationalities, English language proficiency is required
* We enjoy collaborating in person, and the team is working on\-site



**Why you'll enjoy working with Manatal** 



* Well\-funded start\-up backed by Surge \& Sequoia
* Be part of one of the fastest\-growing B2B SaaS start\-ups in the region
* You will be collaborating with talented individuals in the industry
* Join a lively and highly international team
* Indulge in a challenging and innovative working culture
* Attractive medical healthcare plan
* Personal development allowance
* 2 weeks of work from anywhere per year

Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced BIM Manager to join our innovative team in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will lead our Building Information Modelling (BIM) initiatives and drive digital transformation across our construction projects.
   

  




* Develop and implement BIM strategies aligned with organizational goals and project requirements
* Oversee the creation and management of BIM models throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of BIM processes
* Establish and maintain BIM standards, protocols, and best practices
* Lead and mentor a team of BIM professionals, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement
* Liaise with clients, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure effective communication and coordination
* Analyze and optimize BIM workflows to enhance efficiency and productivity
* Conduct regular quality assurance checks on BIM deliverables
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in digital construction
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for BIM\-related issues
* Prepare and deliver BIM training programs for staff and project teams


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering or a related field.
* Master's degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in BIM management or a related role.
* Proven track record of successfully managing large\-scale projects using BIM.
* ACC expert with administrative experience.
* BIM certification (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional) is advantageous.
* Advanced proficiency in BIM software, particularly Autodesk Revit, Navisworks \& ACC.
* Strong knowledge of 3D modelling and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with project management software and methodologies
* In\-depth understanding of BIM standards, best practices and digital delivery workflows.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Experience with digital delivery implementation in construction projects.
* Knowledge of local building codes and regulations in UAE is advantageous.

**Job Title:** 
 Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high\-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.
   

  

 The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross\-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country\-based execution to a coordinated EMEA\-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI\-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day\-to\-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future\-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution.
* Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.
* Maintain strong alignment with country leadership, ensuring technical delivery supports each country in achieving its annual project targets while applying regional synergies and continuous improvements.
* Drive cross\-country collaboration and resource optimization, enabling flexible deployment of technical expertise across the region.
* Own regional technical capacity planning, forecasting, and utilization, leveraging data and AI\-driven insights.
* Oversee partner strategy and execution, including onboarding, performance management, and management alignment.
* Embed and scale the AI\-powered ARIES methodology across all technical delivery activities.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery quality, efficiency, resource utilization, and partner performance.
* Support country Professional Services Directors in achieving project success, while maintaining strong technical oversight.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including reusable assets, automation, and standardization of deliverables.
* Act as a senior stakeholder in customer engagements, supporting critical projects and ensuring delivery excellence.


**Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, or professional services leadership.
* Proven track record managing large\-scale, complex, multi\-country implementation programs.
* Strong background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation environments.
* Deep understanding of technical architectures, integration, and data platforms.
* Experience with resource management, forecasting, and operational optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation and drive standardization.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills in a matrix environment.

data.jd_text:
Job description:
   

  

**About Us** 

 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
 


**Line of Service Overview** 

 At PwC, our people in tax services focus on providing advice and guidance to clients on tax planning, compliance, and strategy. These individuals help businesses navigate complex tax regulations and optimise their tax positions.
 


**Business Unit Overview** 

 In Corporate Tax, you will focus on offering Corporate Tax advisory working with our Delivery Centre on compliance, dispute resolution and tax accounting services to clients. You will provide advice and guidance on tax planning, strategy, helping businesses optimise their tax positions and navigate complex tax regulations to ensure compliance. 
 



  
 



**Role overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Corporate Tax Director to lead complex engagements across the UAE, advising multinational groups, regional conglomerates, family offices and sovereign wealth funds on UAE Corporate Tax and related advisory matters. The role combines market leadership, technical excellence, and people management, with accountability for client portfolio growth, quality execution, and risk management. You will be a senior member of the leadership team, shaping our go‑to‑market strategy and coaching high‑performing teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes. 
 


**How You’ll Contribute** 

**Key responsibilities** 




 You will support the Corporate Tax Partners and lead and oversee a diverse portfolio covering advisory, compliance, controversy, and transactions: 
 



 Client leadership and advisory 
 


* Serve as lead advisor on UAE Corporate Tax matters under Federal Decree‑Law No. 47 of 2022 and implementing decisions, including group structuring, free zone regimes, participation exemption, interest limitation, deductibility, loss utilisation, business restructuring, and permanent establishment and nexus analyses.
* Lead complex transactions and reorganisations, including due diligence, tax structuring, SPA tax clauses, step‑plan design, post‑deal integration, and tax accounting implications.



 Engagement delivery and quality 
 


* Set engagement strategy, scope, budgets, and staffing plans; ensure timely, high‑quality deliverables aligned to global methodologies, independence, and risk management requirements.
* Review and sign‑off technical analyses, memoranda, models, and client reports; ensure clear articulation of positions and defensibility under UAE law and OECD standards.
* Oversee tax compliance for complex groups, including registrations, elections, group relief/consolidation, returns, and tax accounting/disclosures under IFRS; ensure robust documentation and workpapers.



 Market development 
 


* Drive business development with existing and new clients; originate and convert pipeline; lead proposals, thought leadership, and market eminence initiatives focused on priority sectors (financial services, energy, real estate, technology, consumer/retail, logistics, sovereign/PE).
* Build executive‑level relationships (CFO, Tax Director) and cultivate a trusted‑advisor profile through insights on regulatory developments and market trends.



 People leadership 
 


* Lead, coach, and develop high‑performing teams across grades; provide on‑the‑job training, formal feedback, and sponsorship; promote inclusion and psychological safety.
* Foster collaboration across service lines (TP, Deals, Legal, Audit, Consulting) to deliver integrated solutions and develop next‑generation leaders.



 Risk, ethics, and operations 
 


* Uphold the firm’s quality, independence, confidentiality, and information security standards; proactively manage engagement risks and escalation protocols.
* Ensure accurate WIP, billing, and cash collection; deliver profitable growth against targets.


**What You’ll Bring** 

**Qualifications and experience** 



* 12\+ years of relevant corporate/international tax experience, with significant time in a Big Four or leading law/consulting firm; strong UAE/GCC exposure required.
* Deep technical command of UAE Corporate Tax law and guidance.
* Proven track record leading large, multi‑jurisdictional engagements and managing senior client stakeholders.
* Demonstrable business development success, with experience originating and closing sizable advisory projects.
* Strong understanding of IFRS tax accounting (IAS 12\) and reporting for groups; familiarity with GloBE deferred tax, safe harbours, and data requirements will be an advantage.
* Experience with Revenue Authority interactions, audits, rulings/clarifications, and dispute strategies will be an advantage.



**Education and professional credentials** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Recognised tax/accounting qualification preferred (e.g., ADIT, CTA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent).
* Arabic language skills are advantageous; fluency in English is required.



**Technical and leadership competencies** 



* Expert written and oral communication, with the ability to translate complex rules into pragmatic, commercially grounded advice.
* Strong financial modelling and data literacy; ability to guide clients on tax data, systems, and controls, including Pillar Two data readiness.
* High judgment and negotiation skills; capable of defending positions and navigating regulatory dialogue.
* Inclusive leadership, team building, and coaching at scale; resilient under pressure with excellent project management discipline.



**Technology and data** 




 You are proficient with MS Office and tax compliance platforms, and familiar with data extraction and transformation for tax compliance and reporting. You are comfortable utilising and developing market leading tax technology to support your role and deliver value to our clients, including AI, automation and analytics. 
 


**How You’ll Make a Difference** 

 At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.  
 


**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC** 

 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job \- you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading international consumer organisation undergoing a significant phase of operational evolution and regional transformation across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
 



  





 This appointment represents a strategically critical leadership hire, responsible for shaping and embedding a future\-ready operational model capable of supporting long\-term regional growth, scalability, efficiency, and commercial agility across diverse and evolving markets.
 



  





 Operating at Executive Committee level, the role will lead the transition and centralisation of key operational capabilities into Dubai, redefining how the organisation structures, governs, and executes operations across the region.
 



  





 This is not a traditional supply chain leadership position. It is a broad operational transformation mandate focused on organisational design, operating model evolution, infrastructure optimisation, and cross\-functional integration across complex international markets.
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



  





 The Director of Operational Transformation will be responsible for architecting and executing a large\-scale operational transformation agenda across MEA \& Asia.
 



 The successful individual will act as a strategic partner to regional and global leadership, driving the redesign of operational frameworks, improving organisational capability, enhancing supply network effectiveness, and establishing scalable infrastructure aligned with the organisation’s long\-term ambitions.
 



 The role requires a leader capable of balancing strategic vision with operational execution, while operating effectively across both mature and emerging markets.
 



 This individual will play a central role in influencing how the organisation evolves operationally over the coming years.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategic Operational Transformation
 


* Define and execute a regional operational transformation roadmap aligned with business growth objectives and long\-term organisational priorities
* Lead the redesign and optimisation of the regional operating model across operational functions
* Drive the transition and centralisation of operational capabilities into Dubai, ensuring effective governance, scalability, and regional alignment
* Partner closely with Executive Committee stakeholders to shape strategic operational priorities and long\-term capability development
* Evaluate current operational structures, identify inefficiencies, and implement future\-focused solutions to enhance agility and performance



 Operating Model \& Infrastructure Development
 


* Design scalable operational frameworks capable of supporting multi\-market growth across MEA \& Asia
* Establish governance structures, decision\-making frameworks, and operational standards across regional markets
* Develop integrated operational ecosystems connecting planning, logistics, procurement, distribution, customer operations, and commercial functions
* Support the evolution of regional hub structures, shared service capabilities, and centralised operational functions
* Lead organisational alignment initiatives to ensure operational structures support both regional and local market needs



 Supply Chain, Logistics \& Distribution Transformation
 


* Oversee the transformation and optimisation of regional supply chain and distribution networks
* Drive operational excellence initiatives across warehousing, transportation, inventory management, and fulfilment operations
* Evaluate and redesign logistics infrastructure and 3PL operating models to improve service levels, responsiveness, and cost efficiency
* Establish operational KPI frameworks to monitor service performance, operational efficiency, and network effectiveness
* Drive automation and digital enablement initiatives to improve operational visibility, planning capability, and execution consistency



 Procurement, Partnerships \& External Ecosystems
 


* Lead the development of strategic operational partnerships across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, and external service providers
* Oversee supplier and partner governance frameworks to ensure accountability, scalability, and performance delivery
* Support procurement transformation initiatives focused on cost optimisation, operational resilience, and strategic sourcing capability
* Negotiate and manage complex operational and commercial agreements with regional and global partners



 Transformation Delivery \& Change Leadership
 


* Lead complex, cross\-functional transformation programmes across multiple geographies and stakeholder groups
* Drive adoption of new operational processes, technologies, governance models, and organisational structures
* Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Coach and develop regional operational leadership teams to strengthen organisational capability and succession planning
* Act as a visible transformation leader capable of influencing senior stakeholders across regional and global functions



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading operational transformation, operating model redesign, and regional operational leadership within complex multinational environments.
 



 Candidates will typically come from leading FMCG, consumer goods, beauty, retail, or similarly sophisticated international organisations.
 



 Experience \& Background
 


* Proven experience leading large\-scale operational transformation initiatives across international markets
* Strong operational leadership background spanning supply chain, logistics, procurement, planning, distribution, and operational governance
* Demonstrated experience designing or evolving regional operating models and organisational structures
* Experience leading regional hub centralisation, shared services transformation, or cross\-border operational migration projects
* Strong understanding of operational infrastructure, supply network optimisation, and multi\-market operational complexity
* Experience operating within matrix organisations and engaging with Executive Committee or Board\-level stakeholders
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to align operational strategy to broader business objectives



 Leadership Capabilities
 


* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into executable operational frameworks
* Highly credible stakeholder manager with strong influencing and communication capabilities
* Commercially astute with a balanced understanding of growth, efficiency, and operational sustainability
* Comfortable operating in complex, evolving, and high\-growth environments
* Strong organisational leadership capability with experience developing high\-performing regional teams
* Resilient, adaptable, and capable of leading transformation through ambiguity and organisational change

data.title: Commercial Director
data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent network, and works alongside the VP to close exhibition packages, sponsorship inventory, and feature areas. The role is the senior commercial operator on the AixEnergy team and is accountable for the Year 1 close and the Year 2 rebooking pipeline captured on\-site plus any additional AixEnergy edition launches.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Own the AixEnergy Asia 2026 exhibition and sponsorship pipeline end\-to\-end: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and contract close. Carry an individual revenue target and report progress weekly against the Revenue Pathway forecast.
 



 Open and convert priority accounts across hyperscalers, data centre operators, energy and utility companies, EPCs, industrial real estate developers, and AI infrastructure vendors. Build credible peer\-level relationships with senior commercial decision\-makers and convert verbal interest into signed contracts.
 



  





 Manage and grow the AixEnergy agent network. Set agent targets, brief on pricing and proposition, and quality\-control agent\-sourced leads before they enter the AixEnergy pipeline.
 



 Work on sponsorship sales to convert sponsorship inventory: title partner, strategic partners, theatre and feature sponsorships, and on\-site activations.
 



  





 Maintain Salesforce hygiene to dmg events standard: every opportunity logged, staged, weighted, and updated weekly. Provide accurate weekly forecasts to the VP and into the WSR (Weekly Sales Report) cadence, with clear flags on slipped, won, and at\-risk deals.
 



  





 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
 



 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
 



  





 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
 



  





**Job Context:**




 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. The Commercial Director is joining at a critical phase of the cycle and is expected to close the gap to budget through direct sales, agent activation, and conversion of the existing pipeline. The event is co\-located with Gastech 2026 in Bangkok but operates as a standalone product with its own P\&L, exhibition, sponsorship inventory, and conference. The Commercial Director reports to the VP ADIPEC \& Business Development and works alongside the Operations Director, the Marketing Director and the Head of Content. The role requires a senior operator capable of working independently in an early\-stage commercial environment, holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale and energy executives, and delivering against a hard September 2026 close.
 



  





**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills:**




 Technical / Functional: Minimum 7 years senior B2B exhibition and sponsorship sales experience, with a track record of personally carrying and delivering revenue targets in excess of US$1m. Demonstrable success selling at a senior, peer\-level into AI infrastructure, data centres, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Experience launching first\-edition events strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM is essential. Familiarity with ASEAN markets, particularly Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, is an advantage. Experience working with sales agents and channel partners. Understanding of how exhibition, sponsorship, and conference content combine into a single commercial proposition. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
 



  





 Personal Attributes / Interpersonal: Senior commercial presence; comfortable holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale procurement leads, energy company executives, and EPC commercial directors. Closer’s instinct: identifies the path to contract early and drives the deal to signature. Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate effectively in a launch\-phase environment without established processes or large team support. Resilient under pressure; comfortable with hard targets, weekly forecast scrutiny, and a non\-negotiable September 2026 close. Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy. Collaborative across Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance; treats the pipeline as a shared commercial asset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willing to travel internationally as required, including to Bangkok ahead of and during the September 2026 event.
 



  





**dmg events is an equal opportunity employer. If you have not had feedback from us within 14 days, please consider your application as unsuccessful for this round.**

**Job Purpose:**




 The Conference Manager’s responsibility is to support the Conference Director in delivering all aspects of the conference, including agenda, speaker management and relationships within the industry.
 



 • Manage relationships with industry leaders, partner organisations, vendors, and media
 



 • Programme research and development
 



 • Speaker acquisition
 



 • On\-site delivery that strengthens speaker, attendee and sponsor relationships
 



 • Market intelligence to identify new content opportunities
 



 • Manage the call for papers process and session selection for the technical conference
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Support Conference Director in:
 


* Liaising with event partners, Ministry and committee members
* Organising and running committee meetings to determine conference themes, topics, session chairs, and speakers
* Conducting telephone and in\-person research with stakeholders to develop programme agendas
* Joining sponsorship and exhibition sales calls and meetings with existing and potential clients
* Building an agenda that is commercially viable for both sponsorship and delegate sales
* Recruiting C\-suite, regulator and government speakers to the programme faculty
* Researching and providing strategic information required to market and sell conferences to the marketing and sales functions, including:
* detailed information on the target market both in terms of sector and geographic markets
* relevant industry associations and publications

**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.

**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**
 The Customer Support Executive – EMEA is a customer facing operational role within the Sales \& Commercial function at Skyways Technics’ Dubai (DXB) hub. The role is the primary point of contact for EMEA region customers throughout the order lifecycle, from Purchase Order receipt through to delivery and post sales resolution while ensuring a consistently high quality buying experience that reflects Skyways Technics’ commitment to service excellence. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, commercially aware, and skilled at managing multiple concurrent transactions in a fast paced aviation aftermarket environment, while building strong, trust based relationships with customers and internal teams alike.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Order Management \& Customer Liaison**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for EMEA customers upon receipt of Purchase Orders (POs), ensuring prompt acknowledgement, accurate processing, and proactive communication throughout the order lifecycle.
* Support Sales Managers in all aspects of order processing, administration, and follow up activities, ensuring orders are executed accurately and on time.
* Monitor open orders and flag potential delays, discrepancies, or fulfilment risks to the relevant Sales Manager at the earliest opportunity.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of each customer’s order requirements, urgency levels (including AOG situations), and preferred communication protocols.
* Ensure all customer interactions by phone, email, and all platforms are handled professionally, responsively, and in line with Skyways Technics’ service standards.


**Logistics Coordination \& Shipment Management**
* Coordinate with internal departments and external logistics providers to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant shipment and delivery of all customer orders.
* Track shipment status across all open orders, providing proactive updates to customers and escalating delays or exceptions to the relevant Sales Manager.
* Ensure all shipping documentation, including airworthiness release certificates, packing lists, commercial invoices, and export documentation are accurate, complete, and dispatched with each shipment.
* Coordinate AOG and priority shipments with urgency, liaising with logistics partners to secure the fastest available routing and ensuring customers are kept informed throughout.


**Post Sales Support \& Warranty Management**
* Provide comprehensive post sales support, including coordination of replacement orders, return authorisations, and shipment follow up to ensure full customer satisfaction.
* Monitor and actively follow up on all open warranty cases in coordination with the relevant Sales Manager or Sales team member, ensuring cases are tracked to resolution within agreed timelines.
* Liaise with the technical and quality teams as required to support the investigation and resolution of warranty claims, customer complaints, and return to vendor cases.
* Maintain accurate records of all post sales activities, warranty case status, and customer feedback, ensuring visibility across the commercial team.


**Reporting \& Data Management**
* Prepare, maintain, and distribute weekly reports on open core unit transactions, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery to relevant internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate and up to date records of all customer orders, shipment statuses, warranty cases, and post sales activities within the company’s ERP system (Pentagon 2000\).
* Support the Sales Manager and Commercial Director with ad\-hoc reporting, data compilation, and commercial analysis as required.
* Identify and flag recurring trends or systemic issues in order fulfilment, shipping, or customer feedback, contributing to continuous process improvement.


**Internal Coordination \& Operational Support**
* Act as the operational bridge between customers, Sales Managers, the Stores department, logistics providers, and the finance team to ensure seamless order execution.
* Support the broader sales and commercial team with ad\-hoc tasks and additional responsibilities as required to ensure smooth business operations and timely project completion.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of customer support processes, tools, and communication standards within the EMEA commercial function.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with applicable company procedures, quality standards, and UAE regulatory requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Aviation Management, Supply Chain, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a customer support, sales coordination, or order management role, within the aviation aftermarket, aerospace, or MRO industry.
* Experience handling aviation spare parts transactions, including familiarity with airworthiness documentation (e.g. EASA Form 1, FAA 81303, CoC) is a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high volumes of concurrent orders and customer interactions with accuracy and professionalism.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word); hands on experience with ERP systems, preferably Pentagon 2000, is advantageous.
* Experience working in a fast paced, multicultural commercial environment; prior exposure to EMEA customer bases is preferred.
* Must be based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, United Arab Emirates.


**Key Competencies**
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple open orders, shipments, and warranty cases simultaneously without loss of accuracy or urgency.
* Customer first mindset and consistently delivers a professional, responsive, and solution focused experience that builds long term trust with EMEA customers
* Clear and effective communicator in English (written and spoken); proficiency in Arabic or other EMEA languages is a significant advantage.
* Detail oriented with high standards of data accuracy across order records, shipping documentation, ERP entries, and customer reporting.
* Collaborative team player who works effectively with Sales Managers, Stores, logistics partners, and finance to ensure seamless order fulfilment.
* Commercially aware and understands the urgency and commercial implications of order delays, AOG situations, and warranty escalations in the aviation context.
* Proactive and self motivated, with the ability to identify issues early, flag them promptly, and follow through to resolution with minimal supervision.
* Adaptable and resilient under pressure, maintaining accuracy and professionalism during peak periods and high urgency situations.

* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, authority requirements, quality standards, and project schedules.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks or delays, and implement corrective action plans to maintain timelines.
* Coordinate project activities across civil, carpentry, MEP, and finishing teams to ensure smooth site execution.

* Lead planning, execution, and coordination of all MEP works across projects.

* Coordinate with consultants, mall management teams, authorities, and subcontractors on project\-related matters.

* Supervise and manage in\-house operational teams across multiple projects.

* Strong hands\-on knowledge of MEP systems, authority approvals, and mall coordination processes.

* Strong understanding of project planning, execution, quality control, and site operations.

* Problem Solving \& Decision Making

**Technical Project Manager, Payments** 




  





 Fime is a globally recognised international player providing deep expertise across digital payments, mobility services, and digital identity. We work with leading organisations worldwide to solve complex challenges, identify emerging opportunities, and future\-proof their strategies.
 



  





 Our team of 900\+ experts operates in over 20 locations around the globe, delivering solutions that support millions of transactions every day, across global markets. What sets us apart is our values: we are curious, creative, and highly collaborative, with a strong commitment to integrity \- we do the right thing for our clients, our people, and our shareholders.
 



  





 At Fime, the work is varied and intellectually stimulating. No two days are the same, and you will be surrounded by smart, engaged colleagues who value learning and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Move. Pay. Trust.** 




**Where identity, money, and movement connect.** 




  





**MISSION** 




 As a Technical Project Manager, Payments your mission is to successfully plan, execute, and deliver projects while ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, budget, and quality standards. You will lead project teams, manage resources and risks, and maintain effective communication with stakeholders (after identifying internal \& external stakeholders). By applying Fime – Consult Hyperion project management framework (PM@CHyp) principles, you will oversee project execution, monitor progress, and address deviations promptly. Your goal is to achieve the project objectives, optimize resource utilization, and foster a positive team dynamic. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will proactively manage risks, ensure stakeholder engagement, and implement quality control measures. Ultimately, your mission is to drive the project successfully, promote continuous improvement, and deliver valuable outcomes that meet stakeholder expectations.
 



  





 Projects scope includes delivering consultancy services and certification test platforms to the Payment, Smart Mobility and Digital Identity ecosystems stakeholders. Main customers are International and Domestic Payment Schemes, Payment Service Providers, Financial Institutions, Transport Authorities, Digital Identity Service Provider.
 



  





**ACTIVITIES** 



* **Project Planning** 
 : Collaborate with stakeholders to define project goals, objectives, scope, and deliverables. Develop a comprehensive project plan, including task breakdown, timeline, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.
* **Team Management** 
 : Assemble and lead project teams, assign activities, provide guidance, and foster collaboration. Ensure effective communication, resolve conflicts, and motivate team members to achieve project objectives.
* **Project Execution** 
 : Oversee the execution of project activities, ensuring that tasks are completed as per the defined plan. Monitor progress, track milestones, and manage any deviations or issues that arise during project implementation.
* **Scope and Change Management** 
 : Manage project scope by defining and controlling project boundaries. Evaluate change requests, assess their impact, and implement changes while maintaining project objectives and minimizing scope creep.
* **Stakeholder Management** 
 : Engage with project stakeholders, including clients, sponsors, and team members. Maintain regular communication, manage expectations, and address stakeholder needs and concerns throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Risk Management** 
 : Identify, assess, and manage project risks. Develop risk mitigation and contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential risks on project outcomes. Monitor risks and take proactive measures to address them.
* **Quality Assurance** 
 : Establish quality control processes to ensure that project deliverables meet defined standards and stakeholder expectations. Conduct regular reviews, inspections, and testing to maintain high\-quality outcomes.
* **Resource Management** 
 : Optimize resource allocation to ensure efficient utilization of project resources, including personnel, equipment, and materials. Monitor resource availability, adjust as needed, and manage dependencies.
* **Communication and Reporting** 
 : Maintain effective communication channels with stakeholders, providing regular project updates, progress reports, and key milestone achievements. Foster transparent and timely communication to ensure project transparency.
* **Project Closure:** 
 Facilitate proper project closure by conducting post\-project evaluations, capturing lessons learned, and documenting project outcomes. Ensure the orderly handover of deliverables and transition of project responsibilities.



  





**JOB EXPERIENCE** 



* At least 7 years’ experience in project management roles, with proven track record of managing complex projects or portfolios
* Proven experience within Payment Schemes, Issuing, Acquiring and Payment Service Providers technical environments and standards. Experience across Fare Collection and Ticketing systems is a welcome advantage



  





**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS** 



* Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field
* Project management certification is a plus (PMP or equivalent)

* Customer oriented attitude and good interpersonal and presentation skills
* Outstanding leadership and communication skills
* Strategic thinking and decision\-making abilities
* Strong analytical skills, Self\-motivated committed and team player

Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We're made up of people from 60\+ nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
   

  

 If our incredible culture sounds like you, we'd love you to join us.
   

  

**The opportunity.**
 As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end\-to\-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
   

  

 You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
   

  

 As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.

* You'll drive successful outcomes \- delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T\&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.

 What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

* Company bonus

 We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We're not a start\-up. Not anymore. But we've not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction \- the future.
   

  

**It's All About You.**
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected—because it's your individuality and passion that make you
 *Q* 
 . We see that, and we celebrate it. That's why we're proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know—we're happy to assist.
   

  

 No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what's possible, we want to hear from you.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Category \& Merchandising** 




  





 About the Role
 



  





 Fynde has partnered with a global cross\-border eCommerce platform that specialises in bringing international products to customers across the Middle East and wider international markets. With a strong presence across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, the business simplifies access to millions of global products by managing sourcing, import logistics, and last\-mile delivery through a seamless, consumer\-first digital experience.
 



  





 We are now headhunting a Head of Category \& Merchandising to take strategic and commercial ownership of category performance across the platform, with an initial focus on Health \& Supplements alongside broader involvement across multiple product categories within the organisation.
 



  





 Based in Dubai, this is a commercially driven leadership role focused on category growth, merchandising strategy, localisation, digital trading performance, and customer engagement across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. The position blends category management, product selection, pricing, ecommerce merchandising, analytics, and AI\-enabled optimisation, requiring someone capable of shaping both strategic direction and operational execution within a fast\-paced cross\-border ecommerce environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Category \& Commercial Ownership** 




 Lead the strategy, development, and ongoing performance management of key product categories across the platform, with a particular focus on Health \& Supplements. Drive revenue growth, margin optimisation, customer engagement, and category expansion in alignment with wider business objectives across multiple international markets.
 



  





**Assortment Development \& Curation** 




 Build commercially relevant and scalable product assortments based on customer behaviour, market trends, data analysis, and commercial opportunity. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen category depth, introduce new products, and optimise the product mix across both regional and international audiences.
 



  





**Product Performance \& Trading Analysis** 




 Use dashboards, sales reporting, customer insights, and trading data to evaluate category performance and identify opportunities for optimisation. Analyse SKU performance, pricing effectiveness, conversion trends, promotional impact, and customer demand to drive commercial decision\-making.
 



  





**Pricing \& Promotional Strategy** 




 Develop and optimise pricing strategies in line with consumer expectations, competitive positioning, and margin objectives. Plan and execute promotional activity to support seasonal campaigns, category growth initiatives, and overall trading performance.
 



  





**Regional \& International Localisation** 




 Support the localisation and optimisation of category content, product presentation, and customer experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. Ensure merchandising strategies align with local consumer behaviours, cultural nuances, and evolving market expectations.
 



  





**AI \& Merchandising Automation** 




 Partner with data and technology teams to leverage AI, automation, and merchandising tools to improve category performance. Contribute towards initiatives involving product recommendations, dynamic pricing, search optimisation, inventory visibility, and broader ecommerce automation strategies.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with marketing, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and technology teams to ensure strong execution of category plans and alignment across all customer touchpoints.
 



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitor Benchmarking** 




 Monitor developments across ecommerce, health \& wellness, consumer behaviour, and digital merchandising trends. Benchmark competitor activity, assortment strategy, pricing structures, and promotional campaigns to identify commercial opportunities and areas for improvement.
 



  





**Lifecycle \& Inventory Management** 




 Oversee the full lifecycle management of SKUs, ensuring products remain commercially viable, available, and aligned with category strategy. Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to support forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimisation.
 



 Requirements
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience within ecommerce category management, digital merchandising, ecommerce trading, or related commercial functions.
* Strong experience within Health, Supplements, Wellness, FMCG, Consumer Goods, or adjacent ecommerce\-led categories.
* Proven commercial acumen with responsibility for revenue growth, margin optimisation, product mix, and trading performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insight into commercial action.
* Experience working alongside AI\-enabled merchandising tools, pricing engines, ecommerce CMS platforms, or automation technologies.
* Understanding of cross\-border ecommerce operations, digital marketplaces, and international trading environments.
* Experience operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider Middle Eastern markets would be highly advantageous.
* Arabic language capabilities would be highly advantageous.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to build, shape, and improve processes within a growing organisation.
* Ability to operate both strategically and hands\-on within a fast\-moving ecommerce environment.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
