data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 



* To support the Bank’s business strategy by acquiring and managing high\-net\-worth (HNW) clients. The role requires a UAE National Relationship Manager with a strong background in wealth management, capable of delivering tailored financial solutions, enhancing client relationships, and contributing to the growth of the Bank’s HNW client base.
* The role is required to acquire/ transfer HNW clients’ portfolios to Emirates Investment Bank to generate fee income and Assets Under Management (AUM).
* The role must work closely with team leaders, Head of Business Development and Investment Advisors to ensure client product suitability is maintained as per the internal policies.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Client Acquisition and Revenue:** 



* To source new qualified clients for Wealth Management business based on the business plan submitted at the time of on\-boarding.
* To ensure generation of net fee income through the sale of Investment products and to generate the required Assets under Management (AUM).
* To maintain regular contact with the client including regular face\-to\-face meetings and maintain call reports of all client activities.
* To profile the clients’ risk and return aspirations and work with Investment Advisors to maintain client risk profile suitability at all times.
* To increase assets under management of existing clients and develop the relationship.
* To provide and maintain, on an ongoing basis, a monthly report, figures, forecasting and any other records which may be required by the Team Leader to keep up\-to\-date records of sales \& performance.
* To do account planning with Team Leader and Head of Distribution and Investment Advisors to understand the needs of the client and provide appropriate financial solutions to the client.
* To ensure consistent service delivery is maintained at all touch points for clients.
* To continuously provide feedback on competitive activities to the Product and Business team to track market developments.
* To attend regular product trainings and to be updated with the financial market developments.
* To safeguard the Bank’s reputation by ensuring ethical and professional behavior is maintained at all times.
* To maintain superior client service levels by pro\-actively meeting the clients on regular basis and pre\-empting any possible client complaints and concerns.



  





**Client Portfolio Management:** 



* To maintain and enhance new and existing relationships with key and prospective clients to ensure business continuity and growth.
* To provide regular updates to the Head of Business Development/ Wealth Management on performance of the portfolio accounts and on key market updates which may impact client attrition.
* To analyse the client’s financial standing to assess the credit risk for the client and ensure that the credit quality of the portfolio is not compromised.
* To recommend/reject or approve credit facilities, within prescribed limits, after a comprehensive analysis of the client’s net worth and proposed financial standing.
* To ensure provision of high quality and timely service to clients.



**Internal Collaboration:** 



* To monitor service level agreements and manage the coordination with other departments to meet client service expectations.
* To engage with key stakeholders including on\-boarding team, credit, operations, technology, and treasury to deliver a timely and effective level of client experience.



**Regulatory and Compliance:** 



* To ensure that the client being on\-boarded is of good reputation and financial standing and will maintain proper financial and KYC documentation at all times.
* To ensure customer documentation is complete and in line with the Bank’s requirements.
* To help service coordinators in resolving documentation and other client\-related discrepancies.
* To adhere to a robust control framework, ensuring communications with clients meet internal control standards and external regulatory requirements.
* To ensure clients’ KYC and risk profile are reviewed regularly as per compliance policy, and is updated with any new changes in clients’ financial status.
* To ensure risk assessment of the client portfolio is maintained by personally reviewing all proposals, identifying, and assessing all risk inherent in credit exposures.
* To ensure all compliance/ credit and AML queries are answered within 48 hours.
* To ensure all internal and external trainings are attended and CPD hours are completed.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Overall, 10\-15years of experience in Banking and minimum 5\-10 years of experience in Wealth Management/ Private Banking/ Asset Management.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* CISI qualification

* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.

* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.

* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

The
 **Head of Business Intelligence** 
 will own and lead the end\-to\-end BI strategy, architecture and insight delivery across the business. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leadership teams to make faster, smarter and more profitable decisions.
 



 You will build and lead a high\-performing BI function, establish best\-in\-class reporting standards, and partner closely with Commercial, Trading, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and senior leadership to drive measurable business impact.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into decision\-ready insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**BI Strategy \& Architecture** 



* Define and own the group\-wide BI roadmap across DTC and marketplace channels.
* Translate trading, pricing, merchandising, supply chain and finance requirements into scalable data models and reporting layers.
* Design and maintain a single source of truth across brands, regions and channels, despite fragmented upstream systems.
* Set clear ownership of raw data, transformed layers, business logic and reporting views.



**Data Integration \& Pipelines** 



* Lead the structuring and transformation of core data tables including orders, traffic, pricing, promotions, logistics, inventory and returns.
* Build and maintain robust pipelines to support daily, weekly and near real\-time trading decisions.
* Partner closely with technology and data teams to improve data reliability, timeliness and accessibility, and to define new data fields or views where required.



**Reporting, Dashboards \& Analytics** 



* Design decision\-first dashboards that drive action, not just visibility.
* Create standardised reporting frameworks while accommodating brand\-level nuances.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for trading, finance and senior leadership teams.



**Business Partnering \& Decision Support** 



* Act as a strategic BI partner to Trading and Commercial teams, proactively surfacing insights, risks and opportunities.
* Help evolve the organisation from reactive reporting to proactive and predictive insight.



**Data Governance \& Quality** 



* Define clear data definitions, metric logic and documentation to eliminate multiple versions of the truth.
* Implement data quality checks, alerts and reconciliation processes to ensure trust in reporting.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 12\+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics or Data, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong background in e\-commerce, fashion retail or consumer\-facing brands.
* Expert\-level SQL (BigQuery preferred) and deep understanding of modern data warehousing and modelling concepts.
* Advanced experience with BI tools such as Tableau or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis, automation or advanced analytics.
* Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience building and scaling BI teams in fast\-growth, high\-change environments.

Executive Opportunity: Head of Regional Sales (MEA)
 



  





 Zenith Technologies
 



 Location: Riyadh, KSA based
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



 ⸻
 



 About Zenith
 



  





 Zenith Technologies, founded in Melbourne and established across Australasia and the Middle East, is a recognized leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence Systems, and Advanced Security Technologies.
 



  





 For over 15 years, Zenith has partnered with governments, ministries of interior, defense organizations, and elite law enforcement agencies to deliver end\-to\-end mission\-critical solutions that fuse physical, digital, and cyber domains. Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Our Portfolio
 



  





 Zenith’s portfolio reflects a track record of world\-first innovations and proprietary platforms that transform how governments and agencies secure their nations. Key domains include:
 



 • Intelligent Mobility \& Enforcement Systems – including the world’s first AI\-powered Intelligent Lightbar, combining ANPR, live data analytics, communications, and edge AI for real\-time enforcement and situational command.
 



 • Next\-Generation ANPR \& Video Analytics – advanced fixed, mobile, and covert platforms enabling real\-time vehicle intelligence, threat detection, and multi\-domain data correlation.
 



 • AI\-Powered Data Fusion \& Analytics – proprietary platforms that ingest and integrate structured and unstructured data streams, delivering actionable intelligence and predictive insights to decision\-makers at speed.
 



 • Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) \& Social Media Monitoring – cutting\-edge solutions for live monitoring, deep\-data correlation, and AI\-enhanced threat intelligence across open sources, social media, and digital ecosystems.
 



 • Command \& Control Solutions – scalable, integrated C4i platforms enabling strategic oversight, rapid response, and mission\-critical decision\-making across multiple agencies.
 



 • Cyber\-Physical Security Integration – bridging digital and physical domains to deliver end\-to\-end national security resilience against emerging threats.
 



  





 Zenith’s unique strength lies in IP ownership and in\-house R\&D, enabling us to deploy fully integrated ecosystems rather than fragmented systems — a decisive advantage in the Homeland Security, National Resilience, and Law Enforcement sectors.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 Zenith is seeking a Head of Regional Sales (MEA) to drive strategic expansion across the GCC, with primary focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this executive will lead Zenith’s market growth, government engagement, and multimillion\-dollar program delivery across one of the world’s most dynamic security environments.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Key Accountabilities
 



 • Define and execute regional sales strategy aligned with Zenith’s growth objectives.
 



 • Lead high\-level engagements with Ministries of Interior, law enforcement, and homeland security agencies across KSA and GCC.
 



 • Manage full lifecycle: pipeline development, bid and proposal management, high\-stakes negotiation, and closure of complex projects.
 



 • Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing regional sales force.
 



 • Establish and deepen strategic alliances with leading system integrators and security partners.
 



 • Deliver strong commercial outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and market leadership.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • 10\+ years in senior sales leadership within Homeland Security, Security Technology, or Defense.
 



 • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable success in the GCC, with direct experience engaging KSA MOI.
 



 • Proven track record in structuring and closing multimillion\-dollar government security contracts.
 



 • Strong professional networks across security, defense, and law enforcement communities in the region.
 



 • Master’s degree (Business or Engineering), MBA preferred.
 



 • Fluent in both Arabic and English.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 What Zenith Offers
 



  





 This is a high\-impact executive mandate within one of the most respected innovation\-driven players in the homeland security sector. Zenith offers:
 



 • Attractive executive package (base \+ commission).
 



 • Opportunity to shape national\-level security transformation.
 



 • A platform to operate at the intersection of AI, intelligence, and homeland security innovation in one of the fastest growing regions globally.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Submit your CV (PDF/Word) to employment@zenith.com.au
 



 Subject line: “Head of Regional Sales (MEA) – \[Your Name]”
 



  





 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

**About the Role:** 




 The Head of QA is the enterprise quality authority, responsible for transforming RAKBANK’s approach to software quality into a modern, automation\-first, AI\-driven quality engineering function.
 



  





 This role will lead the shift from manual, end\-of\-cycle testing to continuous, embedded quality across the full software development lifecycle. Working closely with Digital, Engineering, and Platform teams, the role ensures all releases meet the robustness and compliance standards required in a regulated banking environment.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 



* Define and drive the enterprise QA strategy, including automation\-first and AI\-assisted testing adoption
* Establish and lead a Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence, standardising tools, frameworks, and best practices
* Embed quality across the SDLC through shift\-left practices, CI/CD quality gates, and squad\-level ownership
* Own test automation strategy across UI, API, and data layers; track coverage and ROI
* Implement AI\-driven testing (e.g., self\-healing automation, intelligent test prioritisation, defect triage)
* Lead non\-functional testing (performance, resilience, security, and API contract testing)
* Govern test environments and test data management, including synthetic data and data masking
* Oversee UAT governance and own release quality sign\-off (go/no\-go decisions)
* Define and report QA metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, cycle time, incident rates)
* Build and lead the QA function, including capability development and team structure



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 12\+ years of experience in software quality engineering
* 5\+ years in a senior QA leadership role (Head / Director level)
* Experience in banking, fintech, or regulated financial services environments
* Proven track record of leading QA transformation from manual to automation\-led environments
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, and CI/CD\-integrated quality practices
* Exposure to AI\-driven testing and emerging QA technologies
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar
* ISTQB Advanced Test Manager certification (preferred: Expert level or equivalent)



  





**Skills:** 



* QA strategy and transformation leadership
* Automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.)
* CI/CD integration and quality gate governance
* Performance testing and resilience engineering (JMeter, Gatling, k6\)
* Test data management (synthetic data, PII masking, governance)
* AI\-driven testing tools and practices
* Stakeholder management and executive reporting
* Team leadership, mentoring, and capability building



  





**What You’ll Gain:** 



* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives
* Medical coverage for you and your family
* Comprehensive life insurance
* Exposure to high\-impact strategic projects
* Supportive and inclusive workplace culture
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary** 




 The Director – Investment Risk will lead the design, implementation, and oversight of the firm’s investment risk framework across private markets, real estate, structured products, and alternative investments.
 



  





 The role ensures robust risk governance across deal underwriting, portfolio monitoring, valuation oversight, liquidity management, and concentration limits — while enabling business growth within defined risk appetite.
 



 This is a senior leadership position requiring deep technical expertise, strong commercial judgment, and regulatory awareness.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Investment Risk Framework \& Governance
 


* Develop and maintain the firm’s investment risk framework across asset classes (Private Markets, Credit, Real Estate, Structured Products, etc.).
* Define risk appetite statements, portfolio concentration limits, and exposure thresholds.
* Establish risk policies covering underwriting, valuation, impairment, and exit risk.
* Chair or co\-chair Investment Risk Committee.



  





 2\. Transaction \& Deal Risk Assessment
 


* Independently review investment proposals prior to IC approval.
* Challenge underwriting assumptions (IRR, DSCR, leverage, exit multiples, sensitivities).
* Assess counterparty risk, sponsor quality, covenant strength, and structuring risks.
* Review downside cases and stress scenarios.
* Provide formal written risk opinions to the Investment Committee.



  





 3\. Portfolio Risk Monitoring
 


* Monitor portfolio exposures (sector, geography, sponsor, asset class).
* Develop early warning indicators for deteriorating assets.
* Oversee watchlist process and restructuring risk reviews.
* Assess liquidity risk and funding mismatches.
* Report portfolio risk metrics to management.



  





 4\. Market \& Liquidity Risk Oversight
 


* Monitor interest rate, FX, and credit spread exposure.
* Assess macroeconomic impact on portfolio valuations.
* Oversee hedging effectiveness (if applicable).
* Evaluate exit market conditions for private assets.



  





 5\. Valuation \& Model Risk
 


* Challenge valuation methodologies (DCF, comparables, NAV models).
* Ensure independent model validation processes.
* Oversee stress testing frameworks.
* Review third\-party valuation reports where applicable.



  





 6\. Regulatory \& Compliance Alignment
 


* Ensure alignment with local regulatory frameworks.
* Support ICAAP, stress testing, and capital adequacy exercises (if regulated).
* Interface with regulators during reviews and audits.



  





 7\. Risk Reporting \& Board Engagement
 


* Prepare quarterly Board risk reports.
* Present risk trends and emerging threats.
* Develop dashboards covering:
* VaR (if applicable)
* Exposure limits
* Concentration ratios
* NPL / impairment trends
* Liquidity metrics



  





 8\. Leadership \& Team Management
 


* Lead and mentor investment risk analysts.
* Foster a culture of independent challenge.
* Coordinate with Investment, Treasury, Compliance, and Finance teams.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 10–15\+ years in Investment Risk, Credit Risk, or Portfolio Risk.
* Experience within:
* Investment Bank
* Asset Manager
* Private Equity platform
* Development Finance Institution
* Sovereign / Institutional platform
* Strong exposure to private markets and illiquid asset risk.



**Technical Skills** 



* Deep understanding of:
* Financial modeling
* Stress testing
* Valuation techniques
* Portfolio analytics
* Structured credit
* Experience reviewing complex term sheets and legal structures.
* Strong Excel / risk analytics capabilities.
* Familiarity with risk systems and reporting tools.



**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or Engineering.
* CFA / FRM preferred.
* MBA advantageous.



**Personal Attributes** 



* Independent and strong challenger mindset.
* Commercially aware — not a “box\-ticking” risk officer.
* Strong communication skills with Board\-level presence.
* High integrity and governance mindset.

The role is responsible for overseeing leasing (residential and commercial), resale strate
data.jd_text:
To lead the end\-to\-end asset management function across portfolio, including residential, retail and commercial assets, ensuring optimal asset performance, revenue maximization and long\-term value creation. The role is responsible for overseeing leasing (residential and commercial), resale strategies and asset optimization initiatives, while aligning with broader development and community positioning strategy. It ensures sustainable income generation, high occupancy levels and superior tenant/customer experience across all managed assets.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




**Asset Performance \& Revenue Optimization** 




 · Own and drive overall AUM performance across residential and commercial portfolios.
 



 · Develop and execute strategies to maximize rental yield, occupancy and asset value.
 



 · Monitor asset\-level financial performance including NOI, leasing spreads and ROI.
 



 · Identify underperforming assets and implement turnaround strategies.
 



 . Grow the AUM portfolio, set growth strategies, acquisition, creating a fund platform and further divestment strategies.
 







**Asset and Leasing Strategy \& Execution (Residential \& Commercial)** 




 · Oversee asset and leasing strategy, value creation, pricing and positioning across all asset classes.
 



 · Ensure strong occupancy levels through effective demand generation and tenant mix optimization.
 



 · Drive residential and commercial leasing strategies to attract high\-quality corporate tenants.
 



 · Monitor leasing pipelines, conversions and renewals.
 







**Property Management** 




 · Tenant Management: This includes marketing vacant units, screening applicants, handling leasing agreements, and managing tenant turnovers.
 



 · Maintenance \& Repairs: Responsible for routine upkeep, emergency repairs, and preventative maintenance to keep the property safe and attractive.
 



 · Financial Management: Involves collecting rent, budgeting, managing operating expenses, and providing financial reports.
 



 · Legal \& Risk Management: Ensures compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, such as landlord\-tenant laws and safety codes.
 



 · Operational Oversight: Supervising on\-site employees and coordinating with contractors
 







**Resale \& Secondary Market Management** 




 · Establish and manage resale strategy for residential and commercial units.
 



 · Monitor secondary market trends and pricing benchmarks.
 



 · Work with brokers and channel partners to drive resale velocity and value appreciation.
 



 · Ensure alignment between primary sales, resale and leasing strategies.
 



  





**Portfolio Strategy \& Asset Lifecycle Management** 




 · Define long\-term asset management strategies aligned with master development vision.
 



 · Oversee asset lifecycle from post\-handover stabilization to maturity.
 



 · Collaborate with Development and Sales teams on product positioning and future pipeline planning.
 



 · Provide input into new developments based on market insights and asset performance data.
 







**Market Intelligence \& Reporting** 




 · Track market trends across leasing, pricing and demand dynamics in the UAE.
 



 · Benchmark asset performance against competitors and industry standards.
 



 · Prepare periodic AUM performance reports, dashboards and strategic insights for leadership.
 



 · Provide data\-driven recommendations to improve portfolio performance.
 







**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 · Collaborate with Sales, Leasing, Development, Retail, Marketing and Finance teams.
 



 · Align leasing and asset strategies with brand positioning and community vision.
 



 · Support marketing campaigns for leasing and resale initiatives.
 



 · Ensure alignment between asset management and long\-term business strategy.
 







**Governance, Risk \& Compliance** 




 · Ensure all leasing and asset management activities comply with regulatory requirements.
 



 · Oversee contract structures, lease agreements and risk mitigation frameworks.
 



 · Maintain governance standards across asset operations and reporting.
 



  





  





**Educational Qualification \& Certifications:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration or related field (mandatory)
* MBA or Master’s in Real Estate / Finance / Strategy (strongly preferred)
* Professional certifications such as MRICS (RICS), CFA, CAIA or equivalent preferred
* Executive leadership programs from reputed institutions (e.g., INSEAD, LBS, Wharton) are an added advantage.







**Work Experience:** 



* 20 years of experience in asset management, leasing or real estate portfolio management in the UAE/GCC sector.
* Strong experience managing mixed\-use portfolios (residential, retail and commercial).
* Proven track record in driving AUM growth, leasing performance and asset value enhancement.
* Prior leadership experience managing large, multi\-functional teams.

data.jd_text:
Are you a world\-class growth leader with a proven track record of scaling customer lifetime value (LTV) across global digital products? At Kape Technologies, we’re building the future of cybersecurity and consumer privacy through a diverse portfolio of privacy and security brands, including ExpressVPN, ExpressKeys, ExpressMailGuard, ExpressAI, Identity Defender, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access, EventVPN and Holiday.com.
   

  

 We’re looking for a VP / Director of Lifecycle \& Retention Marketing to own and scale the global lifecycle and retention engine across this portfolio as we expand into new markets and B2B opportunities. In this high\-impact role, you’ll operate at the intersection of growth, product, and data, leading a high\-performing team to shape how millions of users and businesses engage with and stay loyal to our products—while driving Kape’s evolution into a top global cybersecurity company.
   

  

 You will lead a team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle, pricing, and CRO, defining the next generation of retention through AI\-driven personalization, advanced experimentation, and world\-class customer journeys.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

 Define \& Scale the Lifecycle Growth Strategy
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all brands, with a clear mandate to maximize LTV, reduce churn, and accelerate revenue growth. Build and execute a global roadmap spanning onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell, and winback.
   

  

 Lead a Best\-in\-Class Retention Organization
   

  

 Build, scale, and inspire a high\-performing team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle marketing, and CRO. Develop strong leadership layers, elevate talent, and foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and impact.
   

  

 Own Monetization \& Pricing Strategy
   

  

 Drive the evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization levers across multiple products. Partner closely with Product and Finance to optimize subscription models, promotions, add\-ons, and upgrade paths that maximize long\-term customer value.
   

  

 Drive AI\-Powered CRM \& Personalization
   

  

 Leverage cutting\-edge CRM platforms and AI\-driven tools to deliver highly personalized, data\-driven customer experiences at scale. Continuously evolve segmentation, targeting, and automation strategies.
   

  

 Optimize the End\-to\-End Customer Journey (CRO \& Lifecycle)
   

  

 Own the intersection of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and lifecycle marketing, ensuring seamless, high\-converting user journeys across all touchpoints—from onboarding through renewal.
   

  

 Build a Unified Retention Ecosystem
   

  

 Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to create a cohesive retention and monetization engine. Align incentives, roadmaps, and execution to deliver business impact.
   

  

 Champion Data\-Driven Growth
   

  

 Establish best\-in\-class analytics and experimentation frameworks. Deeply understand and optimize key metrics including churn, resurrection, winback, upsell, renewal rates, and LTV.
   

  

 Hands\-On Leadership in a Scaling Environment
   

  

 Operate as both a strategic leader and an execution partner—comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock teams, launch initiatives, and drive results, especially in a high\-growth or smaller company environment.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 8–10\+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, or growth marketing within high\-scale digital, SaaS, or cybersecurity businesses
* Proven track record of driving LTV growth, reducing churn, and scaling monetization
* Leadership experience managing teams of 10\+, with the ability to build and scale organizations
* Deep expertise in CRM, lifecycle marketing, experimentation (CRO), and retention strategy
* Strong experience with pricing and subscription monetization models
* Familiarity with AI\-driven marketing tools, automation, and advanced segmentation
* Highly data\-driven, with strong analytical and experimentation capabilities
* Hands\-on operator who can execute as well as lead
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaborator across Product, Sales, Data, and Customer teams
* Clear, compelling communicator who can align and inspire at all levels


**Before you apply**
* At the moment, we do not sponsor visas in the EU. For Hong Kong, we require at least two years of working experience and a university degree in a related field. For Singapore and the UK, we can only sponsor visas for mid\-career or above.
* Please upload your resume as a PDF and do not include any salary or compensation information in it.


*ExpressVPN is one of the world’s leading providers of online privacy and security services for consumers. Started in 2009, we’ve grown to have millions of active paying customers, a team of more than 700 people worldwide, and a brand recognized by hundreds of millions of people in 18 languages and more than a hundred countries. We see huge growth in our industry, and are gaining market share through strong execution.*

 webook.com is looking for a Director of Strategy to establish and lead the company's Strategy Management Office (SMO). Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer, this role will work closely with executive leadership and key stakeholders across the business.
   

  

 This position is suited for someone who enjoys building functions from the ground up, creating structure in fast\-moving environments, and driving strategic initiatives from concept through execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy Management Office**

* Coordinate quarterly business reviews and strategic planning cycles
* Track execution of company\-wide strategic initiatives and ensure accountability across departments
* Develop reporting frameworks for executive leadership and board visibility


**Corporate Strategy \& Expansion**
* Support the development and execution of corporate strategy across existing and future markets
* Build market assessment and expansion frameworks for international growth opportunities
* Lead cross\-functional strategic initiatives and monitor delivery against targets


**Investments \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Partner with the investments team on evaluating acquisitions, partnerships, and venture opportunities
* Support commercial and strategic due diligence processes
* Assist with integration planning and post\-deal execution where required
* Develop frameworks for assessing strategic fit and long\-term value creation


**Executive \& Board Engagement**
* Prepare board materials, strategic presentations, and investor\-facing narratives
* Support communication with institutional shareholders and strategic stakeholders
* Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to senior leadership


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead and develop members of the strategy team
* Strengthen internal capabilities across strategic planning, execution management, and analytical problem\-solving
* Foster a high\-performance and ownership\-driven culture within the function


**Requirements**
* 8\-12 years of experience in strategy, corporate development, transformation, or a related field
* Experience building or leading a Strategy Management Office or similar strategic execution function
* Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from strategy through implementation and measurable business outcomes
* Background within high\-growth, scale\-up, PE\-backed, VC\-backed, or pre\-IPO environments
* Exposure to M\&A, partnerships, investment evaluation, or market expansion initiatives
* Experience preparing and presenting materials for senior executives or boards

**Preferred Background**
* Experience in live events, entertainment, sports, marketplaces, or consumer technology
* Familiarity with the Saudi and broader MENA business landscape
* Exposure to international expansion across multiple markets


**Why Join webook.com**
* Opportunity to shape strategy at one of the region's most prominent growth\-stage companies
* Direct exposure to executive leadership, institutional shareholders, and board\-level decision\-making
* Ability to build and define a strategic function from the ground up
* Fast\-paced environment with significant regional and international growth ambitions


**This Role May Not Be Suitable For**
* Candidates whose experience is primarily advisory or consulting\-based without operational ownership
* Individuals who have supported strategy functions but not directly led execution
* Candidates who rely heavily on established structures and processes rather than building them
* Limited exposure to executive stakeholder management

data.jd_text:
**Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.
* Adhere to the safety regulations set by the company as well as the Client.
* Provide on monthly basis with a safety statistic report for the individual’s entire operation.
* Liaise with the Client on all matters related to Safety.
* Conduct safety meetings with all the department heads and establish a safety committee to closely monitor and update management on safety matters.
* To perform any other duties requested by the CEO out of the normal routine but within the scope of work.
* The individual is fully responsible and accountable for the HSE policies and procedures, which are in place.
* To conform to the Company’s guidelines related to the area as detailed in the Company’s Quality Assurance Program developed on the basis of ISO 9001:2000 Q.M. S


**All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:**
* Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person\-Centered care values.
* Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
* Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job\-related safety concerns.
* Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
* Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
* Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
* Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.


**Requirements**
* Minimum 10 years operational experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Experience in facility management and healthcare environments from a well reputed local or international companies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA from an accredited University.
* Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.

**About This Role**
**Important note: This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The selected candidate must be located in Riyadh.**
 As the Rare Disease Business Unit Head for the GCC, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and executing the rare disease strategy across the region. You will drive the successful launch and expansion of innovative therapies in areas such as SMA HD, ALS, and Friedreich’s Ataxia \- ensuring patients gain timely access to life\-changing treatments.
   

  

 You will lead the Rare Disease Business Unit across GCC countries, overseeing strategy, operations, and performance. Working in close partnership with the GCC Leadership Team and global stakeholders, you will build a high\-performing organization, ensure cross\-functional excellence, and deliver both patient impact and business results.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and execute the GCC rare disease commercial strategy at the local level, in close alignment with regional and global teams
* Establish and lead high\-performing cross\-functional in\-country teams, ensuring full launch readiness across medical, value \& access, sales, and supply
* Drive the successful launch and expansion of therapies across SMA, including SMA HD, as well as ALS and FA
* Lead the development and execution of country\-specific account plans to maximize patient access and organizational impact
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to adapt and localize marketing, medical, and value \& access strategies to local market needs
* Lead local segmentation and targeting processes, ensuring effective resource allocation and execution
* Define and oversee local sales targets, incentive structures, and performance review processes for commercial teams
* Own full P\&L responsibility for the Rare Disease Business Unit, delivering against financial and operational KPIs
* Build the necessary pathways and processes to accelerate approval, access, and reimbursement across GCC markets
* Ensure all launch activities are executed on time, on budget, and in compliance with internal governance and launch excellence frameworks
* Act as a key strategic partner to regional and global teams, providing insights on local market dynamics, opportunities, and challenges
* Establish strong governance and collaboration models with specialty business units to ensure alignment and effective use of shared resources
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including healthcare professionals, payers, professional organizations, and patient advocacy groups
* Partner with local and regional functional leaders to design and execute effective stakeholder engagement strategies
* Strengthen and maintain the organization’s reputation within the rare disease community through trusted and compliant engagement


**Who You Are**
 You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with a passion for making a meaningful impact in rare diseases. You thrive in complex, fast\-evolving environments and bring a strong balance of vision and execution.
   

  

 You are known for your ability to lead through influence, build high\-performing teams, and navigate cross\-functional and multicultural environments. You combine strong business acumen with deep empathy for patients, ensuring that every decision contributes to better outcomes.
   

  

 You are collaborative, resilient, and driven, capable of translating strategy into action while inspiring those around you.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* 10\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with a significant number of years in a leadership role
* BSc/BA required (MBA preferred)
* Strong experience in rare diseases or specialty care strongly desired
* Proven track record of leading successful product launches across multiple markets, including pre\-launch, launch readiness, and post\-launch execution
* Demonstrated leadership experience building and managing high\-performing cross\-functional teams across multiple countries
* Proven ownership of full P\&L, including delivering financial targets and performance management
* Deep expertise in market access, pricing, reimbursement, and healthcare systems within the GCC region
* Strong understanding of Saudi Arabia, with relevant experience working in the market
* Strong experience developing and executing local commercial strategies, including account planning, segmentation, and targeting
* Experience defining sales targets, incentive structures, and performance management frameworks
* Proven ability to drive approval, access, and reimbursement pathways in complex environments
* Experience working in matrix organizations, collaborating with regional and global stakeholders
* Fluent in Arabic and English, with high proficiency in commercial IT systems (e.g., CRM platforms)


 Job Level: Management
   

  

**Why Biogen?**
 We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid\-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well\-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life\-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.
   

  

 At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about our DE\&I efforts.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem
* You do not manage by spreadsheet alone. You understand what motivates delivery teams and how to build a culture that takes ownership of client outcomes
* You have a working knowledge of SaaS architecture, APIs, and cloud\-based implementations \- enough to have credible technical conversations with clients and product teams
* You hold or have held a PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification. You apply methodology pragmatically, not dogmatically
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where process is still being built. You improve the system while running it


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but adaptable
* Client\-obsessed but commercially grounded
* A builder, not just a manager
* Calm under pressure \- and you set that tone for your team


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the CRO
* Case study presentation \- delivery scenario and P\&L walk\-through
* Offer

**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Commercial Director to lead the commercial strategy and delivery oversight for complex projects in KSA. This role will be responsible for managing contracts, procurement, cost control, and commercial risk across multiple Design \& Build packages, including civil works, stations, systems, depots, rolling stock, and track.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Strategic Commercial Leadership**
* Define and implement commercial strategies aligned with programme objectives, market conditions, and client expectations.
* Lead commercial input into procurement planning, contract structuring, and delivery models.
* Ensure commercial alignment across all packages and disciplines.


**Contract \& Claims Management**
* Lead negotiation, administration, and resolution of contracts, ensuring compliance with legal frameworks and client requirements.
* Oversee preparation and management of contract documentation, including Letters of Acceptance (LOA), change control notices, and claims analysis.
* Monitor contract performance and implement mitigation strategies for commercial risks.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Oversee cost planning, budgeting, and forecasting across all workstreams.
* Ensure adherence to cost management guidelines and promote best practices across the procurement lifecycle.
* Support change management processes, including estimating, agreement of changes, and early warning notices.


**Procurement \& Supply Chain Oversight**
* Develop and implement procurement strategies that align with project timelines and commercial goals.
* Manage supply chain relationships and ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
* Review and validate contractor pay applications and ensure timely approvals.


**Risk \& Performance Monitoring**
* Identify and manage commercial risks across the project lifecycle.
* Maintain change management logs and ensure commercial reporting is accurate and timely.
* Establish and maintain consistent commercial procedures across all project teams.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as the senior commercial point of contact for clients, consultants, and contractors.
* Ensure transparency and trust in all commercial dealings and foster long\-term relationships.
* Coordinate with construction and project managers to resolve commercial and contractual issues.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead and mentor commercial teams, including quantity surveyors and contract managers.
* Ensure high professional standards, accuracy, and accountability across the commercial function.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.


**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Construction Law, or related field (Master's preferred).
* Professional accreditation (e.g., MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent).
* Minimum 20 years of experience in commercial leadership roles, with significant exposure to complex programmes.
* Strong knowledge of contract law, cost control, procurement, and dispute resolution.
* Experience in the Middle East preferred.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**

* Life insurance coverage.

* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation \& housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Pharmaceutical Development Company is a leading clinical research organization, providing a Full\-Service End\-to\-End Solution for Phase I to IV clinical trials and NIS /RWE studies in the Middle East and Africa region. Our team is experienced in managing clinical projects from beginning to completion, PDC has been recognized among the leaders as Clinical Research Organization in the region.
 



  





 Due to our successful development, we are looking for highly motivated and responsible candidates for the position of:
 



  





 Name of position: Clinical Project Manager\- Location: Riyadh\- Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Essential Functions and Other Job Information** 



1. Being and serve as the first point of contact to client.
2. Coordination and control over the feasibility, start\-up, clinical and site\-management activities related to a specific clinical trial within the Division.
3. Strict control over the compliance of study milestones: start, patients’ enrolment (overall study) and timelines as per the contract obligations.
4. Control over budget, issue, task, and time management of the project/s under their supervision.
5. Oversights of submission/ approval process to EC/ RA.
6. Communication with sponsors, partner CROs, physicians, third parties and regulatory authorities.
7. Manages the process of creation, approval of all essential documents developed or tailored in\-house as ICF, patient material and translated documents.
8. Responsible for distribution within the team of final approved version of all essential documents (Protocol, IB, CRF, ICF, etc.).
9. Initiate qualification and approval, ongoing management, oversight and dealing with all third parties involved in the study; complete re\-assessment activities.
10. Develops and communicates all study specific plans as PMP, monitoring plan, TMF maintenance plan, communication plan, quality plan, project risk matrix (if applicable) as well as any other study\-specific instructions and guidelines.
11. Ensures on time study team trainings, meetings, and customization of study\-specific forms and plans.
12. Control over all logistic procedures related to the study.
13. Identify changes, work with team members to quantify financial/ time impact and communicate those changes to appropriate personnel.
14. Ensures the contracting process, when required.
15. Timely coverage of all assigned trainings.
16. Adheres to the rules and regulations of ICH\-GCP and other regulatory and ethical guidelines and data protection regulations.
17. Coordinates activities between different stakeholders and determine interim study time points.
18. Providing any requested internal progress reports and completion of the relevant files.
19. Preparation and conducting of Investigator Meetings in close collaboration with the client.
20. Collaboration with internal/ external auditors, co\-monitors, or regulatory inspectors in review of files and patient data.
21. Executes any activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, instructions, and principles.
22. Development and update of company SOPs and policies in close collaboration with Management.
23. Support Business Development activities in terms of meetings and budget development as applicable.
24. Supervises and assesses the performance of team members and provides feedback to respective line manager/ HR for appraisal.
25. Perform CPL activities as per assigned clinical trials in all cases as deemed necessary by superior management levels, while avoiding risk of conflict of interest.

 • University degree with life science background or equivalent and relevant formal academic/ vocational
 



 qualification.
 



 • At least 6 years of experience in the field of clinical research; Managing at least 5 Interventional CT.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** 




 • Advanced knowledge of GCP guideline and all applicable clinical research requirements
 



 • Proficiency in English language
 



 • Leadership and good sense of teamwork
 



 • Excellent analytical, organizational, negotiation and decision\-making skills
 



 • Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to
 



 and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
 



 • Good time management and multitasking skills to coordinate several issues simultaneously.
 



 • Solid interpersonal skills
 



 • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in\-house and off\-the\-shelf.
 



 • Appropriate MS Office Skills
 



 • May interact with others, relating and gathering sensitive information. Interaction includes diverse
 



 groups.
 



 • Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions based on task prioritization.
 



 • Ability to perform under stress.
 



 • Regular and consistent attendance
 



  





**Working Conditions and Environment** 




 • Work is performed in an office or clinical environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
 



 • Often travels/ drives to site locations. Frequent travel both domestic and international.
 



  





**The Company Offer:** 




 \- Job\-specific training
 



 \- Work for successful international company, excellent career development opportunity in a perspective professional field
 



 \- Very competitive remuneration package
 



 \- Additional benefits related to work performance.
 



  





**Website** 




 https://pdc\-cro.com
 



  





 The Assigned Country: Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Only short\-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.** 




  





 By submitting your application, you agree that your personal data will be processed by PDC in accordance with the applicable Data Protection Law and in strictly keeping your confidentiality.

As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Event Operations Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year\-round programming
* Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
* Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
* Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans


**Logistics, Site Readiness \& Overlay**
* Lead planning and execution of logistics, site readiness, and event overlay (temporary infrastructure, structures, utilities, and services)
* Ensure readiness of all operational infrastructure prior to opening and across event cycles
* Oversee site setup, dismantling, and transition between events or programming phases
* Coordinate movement planning including access, transport, parking, and crowd flows


**Health, Safety \& Security (HSE)**
* Establish and enforce HSE and security frameworks across all operations
* Oversee crowd management planning, emergency response, and incident management protocols
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and authority requirements
* Coordinate with security agencies and government entities to ensure safe delivery


**Guest Experience \& On\-Ground Delivery**
* Ensure delivery of a high\-quality, safe, and seamless visitor experience across all touchpoints
* Oversee guest flow, queue management, accessibility, and service standards
* Monitor on\-ground performance and address operational issues in real time


**Vendor \& Operator Management**
* Oversee management of all operational vendors, contractors, and service providers
* Ensure vendor performance meets operational, safety, and service standards
* Coordinate with procurement and contract management functions


**Cross\-Functional Integration \& Feasibility**
* Lead operational feasibility assessment of programming, commercial, and marketing initiatives
* Ensure alignment between programming requirements and operational capabilities
* Work closely with:
+ Programming → feasibility and scheduling
+ Commercial → activation requirements
+ Marketing → campaign\-driven demand


**Asset \& Site Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with Asset \& Site Management on facilities, maintenance, and infrastructure readiness
* Ensure operational alignment with permanent and temporary asset requirements
* Support long\-term planning of site usage and capacity


**Asset Management \& Group Alignment**
* Align operational plans with Asset Management direction and performance expectations
* Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
* Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews


**Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track operational KPIs including service levels, efficiency, and safety
* Monitor performance during events and identify improvement opportunities
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across operations


**Key Success Metrics**
* Operational delivery against plan
* Visitor experience and satisfaction
* Health, safety, and security performance
* Efficiency of event execution
* Readiness and delivery of major events


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong experience in large\-scale event operations and delivery
* Ability to manage complex logistics and site operations
* Strong knowledge of crowd management and HSE standards
* Ability to operate in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments
* Cross\-functional coordination and execution capability


**Requirements**
* 12\-15\+ years of experience, with a significant portion in leadership roles overseeing large\-scale operations and event delivery
* Proven experience in:
* Planning and delivering large\-scale events, festivals, or destination operations with high visitor volumes
* Managing complex, multi\-site or multi\-zone environments involving diverse activities and stakeholders
* Leading end\-to\-end event operations, including planning, logistics, site readiness, and live delivery
* Strong experience in:
* Crowd management, HSE, and security operations within large public events
* Operational planning and logistics, including transport, access, and site movement
* Vendor and contractor management across multiple service lines
* Demonstrated ability to:
* Operate in high\-pressure, real\-time environments with critical decision\-making responsibilities
* Manage and coordinate with government authorities, regulatory bodies, and security agencies
* Lead large, cross\-functional operational teams and on\-ground workforce
* Experience in:
* Pre\-opening and activation phases of large\-scale venues, events, or destinations (preferred)
* Transitioning from readiness to live operations and managing ongoing operational cycles
