data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work \- not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised.
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal \- not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction.
   

  

 If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well \- this role is for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own delivery from pre\-RFP to go\-live.**
* Lead pre\-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made
* Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery \- with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Ensure every project proposal goes through cross\-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door
* Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness


**Run governance like it matters \- because it does.**
* Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision\-making checkpoints
* Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks
* Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility \- not a sanitised summary
* Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made
* Run post\-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation


**Keep every part of the business aligned.**
* Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery
* Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings \- and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates
* Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read
* Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements


**Manage third\-party and vendor risk.**
* Oversee vendor and third\-party onboarding governance \- tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project
* Maintain a Third\-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners


**Bring the same rigour to internal programmes.**
* Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives \- process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes
* Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership
* Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use


 You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 5\+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi\-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice
* You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them
* You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise
* You have real financial acumen \- cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off
* You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done
* Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience \- whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically \- the framework serves the project, not the other way around
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but not rigid
* Proactive, not reactive
* Calm when it gets complicated \- and it will get complicated
* Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the Head of Services
* Case study presentation \- project governance and risk scenario
* Offer

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.

This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.
   

  

 The purpose of QIMA’s Client Service \& Program team is to deliver seamless certification experience to our clients by managing key programs and ensuring the highest standards of client satisfaction.

* Support the Sales Team to resolve client enquiries and problems with consistency and accuracy.

* Experience in managing a team, customer service, and client management.

data.jd_text:

Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Corporate and Business Development: Source, evaluate, and execute M\&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. Lead cross\-functional due diligence and manage deal execution from start to finish in the KSA
* Drive Strategic Execution: Implement a vision and multi\-year business strategy that balances execution across aircraft sales, business development, corporate development, government relations, OEM, manufacturing, and operations
* Develop Market Awareness: stay apprised of local trends, business opportunities, infrastructure opportunities, consumer mobility preferences, etc., within the KSA, and build action plans to exploit opportunities for Joby
* Collaborate with US Team: Work cross\-functionally with Joby’s US\-based headquarters functions to support global strategic initiatives and to support partner(s) in launching a successful, safe, and compliant service in the KSA
* Establish the Joby Brand Locally: Gather market insights and work closely with Joby’s marketing, business development, and communications teams to build a highly recognizable brand within the KSA
* Be the Local Face of Joby: Serve as the primary local representative of Joby at KSA events and with local press to drive awareness and early adoption

**Required**

**Job Description**
 What if you could shape a career as unique as you?
   

  

 At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.
   

  

 As a
 **Project Manager** 
 you support the Senior Project Manager and Project Director in leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex master planning projects. You will support all aspects of the project, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and stakeholder management, ensuring that the project is completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards to the successful delivery of master plans. This role requires a strong understanding of urban development principles and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Detailed Key Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership \& Lifecycle Management
* End\-to\-End Delivery: Lead the tactical execution of Master Planning projects from inception through to delivery.
* Workstream Integration: Synchronize multi\-disciplinary workstreams—including infrastructure, sustainability, landscape architecture, and transport planning—to ensure a unified project output.
* Revenue Management \& Performance Monitoring: Implement and oversee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) regarding schedule adherence, budget burn rates, and technical quality standards.
* Governance \& Change Control
* Project Reporting \& Performance Management: Lead the preparation and delivery of high\-quality weekly and monthly progress reports (MPRs) for clients, providing clear updates on programme status, key milestones, risks, resource utilisation, commercial performance, and upcoming look\-ahead activities.
* Scope Management: Rigorously monitor project boundaries; identify, document, and manage "scope creep" to ensure commercial viability.
* Change Protocol: Execute formal Change Requests for variations in schedule or budget, conducting impact assessments before escalating for Senior Management approval.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project risks (regulatory, environmental, or financial) and develop robust mitigation strategies to prevent delivery delays.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
* Primary Point of Contact: Act as the central liaison for clients, government authorities, utility providers, and contractors, ensuring transparency and trust.
* Conflict Resolution: Mediate technical or contractual disputes between stakeholders, leveraging professional diplomacy to maintain project momentum.
* Reporting Excellence: Author and present comprehensive monthly progress reports, dashboard updates, and executive briefings for internal leadership and external client boards.
* Quality Assurance \& Documentation
* Technical Compliance: Ensure all deliverables align with local planning regulations, international best practices, and the specific sustainability mandates of the project – by working with the technical leads of the project.
* Document Control: Oversee a rigorous documentation environment, ensuring all deliverables, data requests, email requests and stakeholder approvals are audited and archived correctly.
* Schedule Management: Develop and maintain detailed Project Plans using MS Project or Primavera P6\. Utilize Critical Path Methodology (CPM) to identify and mitigate potential delays.


**Qualifications**
* Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Management or Information Technology.
* Professional Experience: A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in project management for management consultancies or similar. Experience of project management within large\-scale master planning or urban infrastructure is desired.
* Project Methodology: Advanced proficiency in structured frameworks such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile, or Waterfall.
* Software Command: Expert\-level mastery of Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Excel and Word. Primavera P6 is desirable.
+ Design Coordination: Familiarity with InDesign.
+ Data/Commercial: Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, financial modelling)

* Essential Behavioural Competencies
* Self\-Starter \& Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative, thinks ahead, identifies risks and opportunities early, and drives actions forward without the need for close supervision or constant direction.
* Workload Management \& Accountability: Effectively manages own priorities, remains organised under pressure, and can independently balance multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal guidance.
* Team Contribution \& Support: Works collaboratively as part of the wider team, builds strong internal relationships, and actively supports colleagues by sharing workload and contributing where needed.
* Senior PM Support \& Added Capacity: Provides reliable support to the Senior Project Manager by taking ownership of delegated responsibilities, reducing pressure on senior leadership, and stepping in to manage additional tasks during peak periods.
* Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Building: Builds trusted, professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams through clear communication and dependable delivery.
* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.
* KSA Client Environment Experience: Good understanding of client expectations, business culture, and consultant standards when operating in Saudi Arabia.
* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.
* Specialized Knowledge: Experience with KSA Giga\-projects is a significant advantage.
* Advanced Analytics: Use of Power BI and other analytical tools.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**Role Summary**
 The Program Director provides executive\-level leadership and strategic oversight across all LDIP PMCM phases. As the primary point of accountability, the incumbent ensures that all PMCM services are delivered to the highest professional standards, on time, and in full compliance with the requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable national and international standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership \& Program Governance
* Serve as the ultimate professional authority and single point of accountability for PMCM delivery across all phases and sites
* Define and implement the Program Execution Strategy, governance framework, and management methodology; provide executive decision\-making on all scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk matters
* Direct the PMCM team across all disciplines — program management, design, controls, commercial, QHSE, risk, and document control — ensuring consistent performance and alignment
* Design Management \& Procurement (Phase A \& B)
* Oversee PMCM design management across DMP and pre\-construction phases, ensuring Lead Developer outputs comply with LDIP design intent, program objectives, target zoning, plot ratios, and standards
* Direct Value Engineering sessions, procurement strategy development, and tendering processes in compliance with Ministry of Finance regulations
* Construction Supervision \& Contract Administration (Phase C)
* Lead management and supervision of Lead Developer entities across all sites through construction, enforcing compliance with the Terms of Engagement, schedules, regulatory requirements, and quality standards
* Oversee contract administration including payment certification, change order management, claims evaluation, and stakeholder interface coordination with government authorities and utility providers
* Project Controls \& Reporting
* Establish and maintain the Project Controls framework covering schedule, cost, quality, and risk; ensure EVM, KPI tracking, and risk mitigation are implemented consistently across the program
* 
* Review and approve all major deliverables including monthly progress reports, cost reports, risk registers, and schedule updates; provide timely executive briefings and exception reports
* QHSE, Closeout \& Team Management
* Champion a zero\-incident safety culture; direct the Risk Management framework; ensure ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards are maintained across all Developer\-facing operations
* Lead the closeout phase through snagging, commissioning, handover documentation, and the Final Close\-Out Report; ensure all PMCM staff are mobilized within 30 days of written request


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Over 20 years of relevant professional experience; over 12 years in a Project Director or equivalent senior management role
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
* Membership of a recognized Chartered or Professional Engineering Institution
* Demonstrated track record directing large\-scale land development, infrastructure, or urban development programs, ideally in the GCC/KSA context
* International / Western Qualifications and Experience

 Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

 Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report .
   

  

**Project Overview**
 The Ar Rjum Project comprises a green field gold project with three open pit mining operations with associated waste dumps and ore stockpile, a processing plant, tailings management facilities, and supporting infrastructure including water supply, power supply, maintenance facilities, offices, temporary and permanent accommodation village.
   

  

 The Project is situated within the Central Arabian Gold Region, approximately 200 km north\-east of Taif towards Riyadh and about 26 km South of Al Mouwayh, which is a small town situated on the Jeddah \- Riyadh highway.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The project controls manager oversees cost estimating, analysis, and control activities for one or more delivery teams. Supervises schedule development, maintenance, monitoring, impact identification, and recovery plan development activities. Supervises the preparation and presentation of estimates. Supports project organizational and administrative activities. Identifies, examines, and provides innovative solutions to cost engineering and planning/scheduling problems. Provides generally non\-routine cost engineering/planning and scheduling guidance to projects.
   

  

 Reports to and receives technical guidance and operational supervision from designated supervisory personnel. Provides technical and operational direction to assigned personnel. Ensures work is completed as scheduled. Maintains relationships with the Project Manager and project personnel, particularly individual discipline group leaders and engineers. Continuing contacts with Project Manager, project team members, and working and supervisory level personnel of other departments.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Provides comments and recommendations for planning and scheduling/cost engineering requirements relative to staffing and project control. Prepares detailed staffing plans for planning and scheduling/cost engineering activities
* Reviews or assists in reviewing proposal provisions related to schedule/cost engineering and material control, and develops supporting data for contract negotiations.
* Identifies cost trends and schedule impacts for management attention.
* Interfaces with designated Bechtel management and client counterparts for specific planning and schedule tasks/cost presentations.
* Prepares and presents cost engineering/estimating/planning and scheduling information to management/client.
* Coordinates information input into specific studies. Responsible for integration of activities and total work scope identification. Evaluates study results and recommends conclusions for project team consideration and discussion.
* Coordinates and establishes scoping requirements for the overall cost estimate by discipline or other specialty, and coordinates the timely, systematic, and complete acquisition of scope definition and related data. Reviews design scope criteria and quantities for completeness and reasonableness, and coordinates with the project to develop additional estimating bases when information is incomplete. Establishes the conceptual scope of estimates and studies when definition is not available.
* Plans, coordinates, and establishes level of quantification appropriate to the objectives of the effort and to the level of scope definition for each discipline or specialty, and designates reference job(s) for source data and/or reconciliations of quantities. Reviews quantities and their completeness and reasonableness.
* Supervises the timely and competent preparation of cost estimates. Establishes format and content of summaries and reconciliations, including segregation of cost according to level of confidence and identification of areas of risk.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* 25 years of total experience, Minimum 20 years professional experience in project controls with emphasis on cost and project estimating.


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience in performing, monitoring, and reviewing planning and scheduling functions, including schedule development, control, and analysis, and cost engineering functions, including cost estimating, cost control, financial reporting systems, and cost analysis, in the field and the home office.
* Knowledge of supervision, personnel administration, and training of technical and nontechnical personnel.
* Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, direct, perform, review, and present cost engineering and cost estimating products. This includes planning and scheduling products independently with minimal supervision using a high level of professional judgment and knowledge related to technical planning and scheduling skills and engineering design and construction practices.
* Skilled in oral and written communication.
* Demonstrates an advanced level of understanding of general Project Controls technical skills.
* Advanced level of knowledge of engineering, procurement, contracts, construction, and startup work processes, as performed by Bechtel.
* Knowledge of engineering and construction management customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.


**Total Rewards/Benefits**
 For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards

 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is at the forefront of the entertainment revolution in Saudi Arabia, and we are searching for an experienced and financially savvy leader to join our team as the Executive Director \- Finance (Entertainment). This strategic role will oversee financial planning, analysis, and reporting for our diverse entertainment projects, ensuring the company's fiscal health and driving strategic financial initiatives.
   

  

 The Executive Director will play a vital role in shaping the financial landscape of Qiddiya, providing leadership and strategic direction to the finance team, and ensuring that all financial practices align with the company's growth objectives and Vision 2030 goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the finance function for Qiddiya's entertainment developments, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting
* Develop and implement financial strategies that support overall business objectives while maximizing revenue and controlling costs
* Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling for all entertainment projects, ensuring alignment with performance targets
* Prepare and present financial reports and analyses to senior management, highlighting insights and recommendations for informed decision\-making
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and drive accountability across departments regarding financial performance
* Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards, implementing robust internal controls across all financial processes
* Foster relationships with external stakeholders, including auditors, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies
* Lead and mentor a high\-performing finance team, promoting professional development and knowledge sharing
* Support investment analysis and capital budgeting processes for new entertainment initiatives and projects


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (Master's degree or CPA preferred)
* At least 15 years of experience in finance and accounting, with a strong focus on the entertainment or hospitality sectors
* Proven track record of financial leadership in complex, multi\-project environments
* Strong understanding of financial modeling, analysis, and forecasting techniques
* Excellent knowledge of local and international financial regulations and best practices
* Demonstrated experience in leading finance teams and managing financial operations
* Superior analytical skills, with an ability to translate data into actionable insights for executive decision\-making
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in stakeholder management
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities
* Experience in the Middle East region is advantageous


**Benefits**
 Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking a high\-caliber Senior Project Director to lead the successful delivery of a landmark high\-rise tower in Riyadh,KSA. data.jd_text:
**Position Summary**
 The Director of Foundation Year provides visionary academic and operational leadership for
   

  

 Kingdom University's Foundation Year programme — a critical gateway experience designed to
   

  

 prepare newly admitted students for the rigours of undergraduate study. Operating within a
   

  

 greenfield university environment, this role is responsible for designing, launching, and continuously
   

  

 improving a high\-quality, student\-centred Foundation Year that aligns with the academic standards
   

  

 of Arizona State University (ASU), the requirements of the Education and Training Evaluation
   

  

 Commission (ETEC), and the National Commission for Academic Accreditation and Assessment
   

  

 (NCAAA).
   

  

 The Director leads a multidisciplinary team of instructors, coordinators, and academic support staff
   

  

 across General Education, English Language, Mathematics, and introductory discipline\-specific
   

  

 tracks. This position is accountable for student readiness outcomes, curriculum integrity, faculty
   

  

 development, and accreditation evidence across all Foundation Year academic operations. In Year
   

  

 1, the Director will serve as the primary architect of the Foundation Year model — building
   

  

 structures, policies, and quality systems from the ground up.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Academic Leadership \& Programme Design
* Design and oversee the full Foundation Year curriculum framework in alignment with ASU


 academic standards, ETEC licensing requirements, and NCAAA accreditation criteria.
   

  

- 

 Establish clear learning outcomes, progression standards, and academic policies governing
   

  

 placement, advancement, and exit from the Foundation Year.
   

  

* Lead the development of course syllabi, assessment frameworks, and instructional materials


 in collaboration with academic department leads.
   

  

* Ensure vertical alignment between Foundation Year outcomes and first\-year degree


 programme requirements across all colleges.
   

  

* Champion innovative, student\-centred pedagogy including active learning, blended delivery,


 and experiential learning approaches.
   

  

* Team Leadership \& Faculty Management
* Recruit, onboard, and lead a diverse team of full\-time faculty, part\-time instructors, and


 academic coordinators across General English, General Education, and introductory
   

  

 discipline tracks.
   

  

* Establish a structured faculty development programme, including peer observation,


 coaching, and professional learning communities.
   

  

* Conduct regular performance reviews and set clear, measurable objectives for all academic


 staff within the Foundation Year.
   

  

* Foster a collaborative, high\-performance academic culture grounded in evidence\-based


 teaching practice and continuous improvement.
   

  

* Student Success \& Academic Support
* Oversee English placement testing processes and ensure appropriate student grouping and


 section management.
   

  

* Design and implement early\-warning systems to identify and support students at academic


 risk.
   

  

* Collaborate with the Manager of Student Success and Wellness to provide integrated


 academic and wellbeing support services.
   

  

* Monitor student attendance, progression, and performance data — reporting regularly to the


 Provost on readiness and retention metrics.
   

  

* Champion an inclusive, supportive learning environment that reflects Kingdom University's


 commitment to student success.
   

  

* Operations \& Administration
* Develop and manage the Foundation Year academic calendar, timetabling, and section


 scheduling in coordination with the Registrar.
   

  

* Oversee day\-to\-day academic operations of the Foundation Year, ensuring teaching quality,


 resource deployment, and issue resolution.
   

  

* Manage the Foundation Year budget, ensuring cost\-effective staffing models and resource


 allocation aligned with enrolment projections.
   

  

* Administer and optimise the use of the Learning Management System (Canvas or


 equivalent) across all Foundation Year courses.
   

  

* Quality Assurance \& Accreditation
* Build and maintain a robust evidence culture for ETEC and NCAAA accreditation readiness,


 ensuring all Foundation Year processes are audit\-ready from Day 1\.
   

  

* Develop and implement a Foundation Year Quality Assurance framework including


 programme reviews, assessment moderation, and outcome tracking.
   

  

* Produce regular academic reports for the Provost, President, and Board documenting


 student outcomes, programme health, and improvement actions.
   

  

* Lead Foundation Year self\-study contributions and accreditation submissions as required.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Institutional Collaboration
* Serve as the primary liaison between the Foundation Year and academic colleges, ensuring


 seamless student transition into degree programmes.
   

  

* Collaborate with Admissions and Student Recruitment on enrolment planning, student


 profiling, and articulation pathway communications.
   

  

* Engage with ASU academic partners to maintain curriculum alignment and leverage best


 practices from ASU's General Studies and preparatory frameworks.
   

  

* Represent the Foundation Year in academic governance committees, faculty senate


 discussions, and external accreditation forums.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
 Education
   

  

* A doctoral degree (PhD or EdD) in Education, Applied Linguistics, Curriculum \& Instruction,


 or a closely related discipline is required.
   

  

* A Master's degree with exceptional and extensive relevant experience may be considered in


 lieu of a doctorate in exceptional circumstances.
   

  

**Experience**
* A minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in higher education, with at least 3–5


 years in an academic leadership or programme director role.
   

  

* Demonstrated experience designing and managing Foundation Year, preparatory, or


 pathway programmes in a university setting.
   

  

* Experience working within or alongside U.S.\-affiliated or internationally accredited


 universities is highly desirable.
   

  

* Prior experience in a greenfield or start\-up university environment is a significant advantage.


 Technical \& Domain Knowledge
   

  

* Deep knowledge of Foundation Year and General Education curriculum design, outcomes


 based assessment, and academic support best practices.
   

  

* Familiarity with ETEC and NCAAA accreditation standards, or equivalent international quality


 assurance frameworks.
   

  

* Proficiency in Learning Management Systems (Canvas preferred) and academic reporting


 tools.
   

  

* Strong understanding of English language instruction methodologies, placement testing, and


 EFL/ESL learning progression frameworks.
   

  

 Leadership \& Interpersonal Skills
   

  

* Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary academic teams in a multicultural, high


 growth environment.
   

  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills — able to work effectively with


 faculty, students, senior leadership, and external partners.
   

  

* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills, with experience using student data


 to drive instructional improvement.
   

  

* High levels of initiative, adaptability, and resilience — essential qualities for operating in a


 start\-up institutional context.
   

  

 Language
   

  

* Full professional proficiency in English is required (written and spoken).
* Proficiency in Arabic is strongly preferred, facilitating effective engagement with students,


 faculty, and government partners

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented
 **Project Environmental \& Sustainability Manager** 
 to join our site\-based construction supervision team on a major public realm development in Diriyah, which includes a series of iconic and neighborhood parks, open spaces, and over 55 kilometers of streetscape. The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well\-being.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing
   

  

* Report to the Project Director/Construction Director and act as the project lead for environmental management and sustainability on site.
* Develop, implement, and oversee the Project Environmental Management Plan and Sustainability Plan in line with Parsons standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Review and approve the contractor’s Environmental \& Sustainability Plans, CEMP, Waste Management Plan, Pollution Prevention Plan, and related procedures, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
* Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with local environmental regulations, permit conditions, and sustainability targets (e.g., resource efficiency, waste reduction, carbon considerations).
* Conduct regular environmental and sustainability inspections and audits on site, identifying non‑conformances and ensuring timely corrective and preventive actions.
* Oversee management of waste, noise, dust, air quality, water usage, soil protection, ecology, and hazardous materials in accordance with project standards.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring activities (e.g., noise, dust, water quality) and review monitoring reports, ensuring appropriate actions are taken as needed.
* Collaborate with HSE, construction, and design teams to integrate sustainability principles into construction methods, materials selection, waste handling, and site logistics.
* Support implementation of sustainability rating system requirements (e.g., LEED, Envision, or equivalent), including documentation, evidence gathering, and liaison with independent assessors, as applicable.
* Provide technical guidance to Parsons and contractor teams on environmental best practices and sustainable construction solutions.
* Lead or participate in environmental incident investigations, root\-cause analysis, and reporting, and track implementation of corrective actions.
* Prepare and deliver training and toolbox talks on environmental and sustainability topics to project staff and contractor personnel.
* Coordinate with client representatives, regulatory authorities, and third\-party auditors on all environmental and sustainability matters, including inspections and reporting.
* Manage project environmental and sustainability reporting, including weekly/monthly reports, KPI dashboards, and summary presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure that environmental risks and opportunities are identified early, assessed, and incorporated into project risk registers and mitigation plans.
* Support handover and close\-out activities by verifying environmental commitments are fulfilled, documentation is complete, and sustainability targets/credits are properly evidenced.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability from a recognized university.
* in environmental management and/or sustainability on large\-scale construction or infrastructure projects, preferably in a site\-based role.
* Strong knowledge of environmental regulations, standards, and permitting requirements applicable to construction projects in KSA or the GCC.
* Demonstrated experience implementing Environmental Management Systems and sustainable construction practices on major projects.
* Experience with green building/sustainability rating systems (e.g., LEED, Envision, BREEAM, Mostadam or similar); relevant accreditation or certification is preferred.
* Proven ability to lead environmental and sustainability programs, conduct audits, and influence contractor performance.
* Strong communication, coordination, and report\-writing skills, with the ability to interface confidently with clients, regulators, and contractors.
* Familiarity with HSE management systems and the integration of environmental and sustainability requirements within overall project HSE frameworks.
* Experience in KSA or the GCC region is preferred.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.

data.jd_text:
The Medical Readiness \& Training Manager is responsible for building and sustaining a city\-wide culture of emergency preparedness at Qiddiya. The role owns the full cycle of first aid and first responder training, certification compliance, emergency drill planning and evaluation, and event medical readiness. Working within healthcare operations, the Manager ensures that Qiddiya's workforce is continuously trained, certified, and operationally ready to respond to medical emergencies across all venues and activations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 First Aid \& First Responder Training
   

  

* Design, deliver, and continuously improve first aid and first responder training programs aligned with AHA/SHA Heartsaver standards and applicable national requirements
* Develop and maintain training materials including manuals, skill\-station scenarios, simulation scripts, and competency assessment tools
* Supervise and mentor first aid instructors, ensuring consistent delivery quality and standardized assessment across all training cohorts
* Maintain city\-wide certification compliance, ensuring all designated staff hold valid AHA/SHA or equivalent credentials at all times, with proactive renewal tracking
* Coordinate with City Operations, HR, and department heads to embed certification requirements into onboarding and role\-specific duty conditions
* Produce monthly certification compliance dashboards and escalate gaps to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations


 2\.2 Emergency Drills, Simulations \& Performance Reporting
   

  

* Design and manage annual drill and simulation calendar covering mass casualty incidents, medical emergencies, mass gathering scenarios, and venue\-specific response exercises
* Facilitate tabletop exercises and live simulations, coordinating participants across City Operations, and external partners as required
* Evaluate drill performance using standardized checklists, response time metrics, and team\-performance criteria; produce structured after\-action reports with corrective recommendations
* Track corrective action closure and retest through follow\-up drills to confirm sustained improvement in response performance


 2\.3 Public Health Awareness \& Community Outreach
   

  

* Plan and deliver an annual public health awareness calendar aligned with national health observances and Qiddiya's operational calendar, covering priority topics such as heat illness prevention, cardiac health, diabetes awareness, and mass gathering safety
* Coordinate with Marketing \& Communications to produce guest and staff\-facing health education content, including signage, digital materials, and event\-based messaging
* Build and maintain relationships with partner hospitals, referral facilities, and community health stakeholders to support integrated health promotion and care pathways for Qiddiya's workforce and guests
* Measure outreach reach and engagement and report outcomes to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations


 2\.4 Vaccination Programs
   

  

* Plan and supervise staff vaccination drives in coordination with the healthcare provider and Ministry of Health requirements, covering seasonal influenza, meningitis, and other mandated or recommended programs
* 
* Track vaccination coverage rates against defined targets, maintain records, and produce reports for leadership and regulatory submission
* Coordinate logistics for vaccination campaigns including scheduling, venue setup, cold chain compliance, and post\-campaign adverse event monitoring


 2\.5 Volunteer Management
   

  

* Recruit, train, and coordinate a pool of volunteer first aiders drawn from across Qiddiya's workforce, maintaining their certification status and deploying them to supplement professional medical coverage at events and activations
* Develop and manage a roster of volunteer first aid instructors to support scaling of training delivery across the city, ensuring instructor quality through observation, feedback, and standardization
* Recruit and train Standardized Patients (SPs) to support realistic simulation exercises and emergency drills, managing their briefing, role preparation, and performance feedback to ensure high\-fidelity scenario delivery
* Maintain complete volunteer records including profiles, training history, certification status, deployment logs, and performance feedback; recognize and retain high\-performing volunteers to build program continuity


 2\.6 AED Network \& First Responder Readiness
   

  

* Oversee the city\-wide AED placement strategy, maintaining an up\-to\-date inventory of all devices, inspection schedules, and readiness status across all Qiddiya venues
* Build and maintain a layered first responder network across city departments, ensuring adequate coverage of trained lay responders at all operational areas and venues
* Promote the Qiddiya Life Saver program to grow bystander first aid capability among staff, embedding a culture of emergency preparedness across the city workforce


 2\.7 Event \& Venue Medical Readiness
   

  

* Conduct pre\-event medical readiness assessments for major activations, theme park openings, and mass gathering events, verifying that staffing, equipment, and trained responders meet defined standards
* Develop venue\-specific emergency response plans and coordinate readiness briefings with operational teams ahead of activations and high\-footfall periods


 2\.8 Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Prepare and present monthly readiness reports to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations, covering training throughput, certification status, drill outcomes, and AED network status
* Identify and implement evidence\-based improvements to training, drill design, and readiness programs through data analysis, after\-action review, and benchmarking against mass gathering and entertainment industry standards


 2\.9 Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure all training programs, certifications, and readiness activities comply with Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS), Ministry of Health, and Qiddiya governance requirements
* Maintain accurate records of all training, drills, certifications, and readiness assessments to support audit, accreditation, and regulatory inspection readiness
* Support CMS governance by contributing readiness data and insights to the broader healthcare operations reporting cycle


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Emergency Medical Services, Paramedicine, Nursing, Public Health, or a related clinical discipline
* Valid SCFHS professional license in a relevant clinical category
* Minimum 5\-7 years of experience in emergency medical services, healthcare training, or mass gathering medicine, with at least 2\-3 years in a training, education, or emergency preparedness role

**Your next role**
 Buro Happold is supporting the transformation of cities and public services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, aligned with Vision 2030, national transformation programmes, and public‑sector reform agendas. As Director – Transaction Advisory within our Municipal Services team, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping, structuring, and delivering complex public‑sector transactions across the region.

You will work closely with senior public‑sector stakeholders and delivery entities.

**Your key duties**
 As a Director, you will provide senior leadership to our Transaction Advisory and PPP offering within Municipal Services, driving growth, credibility, and excellence in delivery across KSA and the GCC.

* Lead the Transaction Advisory strategy in KSA and the GCC for public‑sector projects, aligned with Buro Happold’s regional growth.

* Mentor and develop regional advisory talent, building a strong, locally grounded Transaction Advisory capability within the Municipal Services team.
* Oversee portfolio performance, ensuring quality assurance, commercial success, and effective risk management across advisory commissions.


**Your Skills And Experience**
 You will bring a combination of regional credibility, transaction expertise, and senior‑level leadership experience.
   

  

 You will have:
   

  

* A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is highly desirable.
* Significant experience in Transaction Advisory, PPP, or Commercial Advisory, gained within a leading consultancy, advisory firm, or financial institution.
* Strong, demonstrable experience in the KSA market, including a clear understanding of government structures, procurement regulations, and the NCP PPP process/Framework.
* A proven track record delivering PPP, privatization, or investment transactions across municipal, infrastructure, or public‑service sectors in KSA and/or the GCC.

* Strong leadership and people‑development skills, with experience building and leading senior advisory teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with confidence operating at ministerial, executive, and board level.
* High analytical rigour, commercial judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.

* Hybrid working arrangements
* Attractive salary and benefits package
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Entitlement to two memberships to professional bodies or subscriptions
* An international culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.


**At Buro Happold, everyone else’s extraordinary is just our everyday.**
**Apply today and be a part of our legacy.**
**A place for everyone**
 Buro Happold values individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.
   

  

 Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.
   

  

 We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing difference allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.
   

  

 Please let us know if there are any adjustments, we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact recruitment@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

The Director \- Operations \& Maintenance is responsible for leading the operational management and maintenance of city assets and public realm infrastructure, ensuring all assets are safe, efficient, compliant, and operationally ready to support the wider development objectives.

 The Director will lead a team of up to 10 professionals and will be responsible for managing contractor performance across multiple disciplines including public realm maintenance, electrical infrastructure, utilities, and wastewater treatment plant operations. The role will also ensure assets are successfully transitioned from construction into operations through structured handover, snagging, defect management, and operational readiness processes.
   

  

 Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the Director will drive operational excellence, governance compliance, health \& safety standards, budget control, and continuous improvement initiatives across all operations and maintenance activities.

* Strong knowledge of operational governance, health \& safety, compliance, and risk management practices.

 WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit WPP.com
   

  

 For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
   

  

**More About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Riyadh\-based PR Group Account Director (or Account Director) to join our Destination, Sport, Entertainment \& Culture team. In this pivotal role, you will lead high\-impact public relations initiatives for some of the region's most significant and exciting projects. You will be responsible for driving strategic client relations, fostering robust media engagement across the Arabic media landscape, and providing exemplary leadership to your team.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead the development and execution of strategic PR and communications plans, overseeing integrated campaigns across destination, sport, entertainment, and culture sectors.
* Cultivate and manage strong client relationships, leading regular meetings, handling ongoing requests, and ensuring the timely delivery of high\-quality outputs.
* Develop and own deep relationships with key Arabic media contacts, including journalists and editors, to drive proactive and reactive media engagement and secure impactful coverage.
* Oversee the strategic planning and flawless execution of all media FAM trips, coordinating closely with KSA Account Executives for logistical support.
* Craft compelling briefing documents, media briefs, key messages, and background materials, ensuring alignment with client strategic narratives and media positioning.
* Provide expert on\-ground communications support for major events, launches, and press engagements, ensuring seamless coordination with media and stakeholders.
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance, timelines, and deliverables to ensure successful execution, strategic alignment, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead, guide, and mentor the KSA team, fostering clear accountability, efficient project delivery, and consistent quality control across all client deliverables.


**Experience That Contributes To Success**
* Proven experience as an Account Director or Group Account Director within a public relations agency setting.
* Extensive and demonstrable background in public relations within the destination, sport, entertainment, or culture sectors.
* Strong media relations expertise, with a particular focus on and established connections within the Arabic media landscape.
* Exceptional ability to develop and produce high\-quality Arabic content and compelling communication materials.
* Fully bilingual proficiency in both written and spoken Arabic and English is essential.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, with a track record of effectively guiding, mentoring, and overseeing PR teams.
* A strong portfolio showcasing successful strategic planning, integrated campaign management, and client relationship excellence.
* Practical experience in providing on\-ground communications support and managing press engagements for high\-profile events.


**You Belong At Burson**
 Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
   

  

 At Burson, we’re an agency of learn\-it\-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a \#BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

 WSP is seeking an experienced Project Handover \& Closeout Manager to support the successful delivery and transition of large\-scale civil infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 This role is critical in ensuring that infrastructure assets are fully completed, compliant, documented, and ready for operational handover to the client. **Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end project handover from construction completion to final client acceptance
* Develop and implement handover strategies, plans, and schedules aligned with project milestones
* Ensure completion of all handover deliverables including as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, asset registers, and testing/inspection records

**Readiness \& Transition**
* Ensure infrastructure is operationally ready including functionality, safety compliance, and usability
* Support smooth transition from construction to operations and formal asset transfer to the client


**Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain structured documentation ensuring traceability and completeness of all closeout records

**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is seeking an experienced HSEW Director to lead and oversee Health, Safety, Environment, and Wellbeing (HSEW) functions for remote projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). This role requires strong leadership in managing HSEW strategies for high\-end luxury hospitality and residential developments, ensuring compliance, safety excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement across all project phases.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall HSEW strategy and execution across remote project sites in KSA.
* Develop, implement, and monitor project\-specific HSEW plans, policies, and procedures aligned with corporate and regulatory standards.
* Ensure full compliance with KSA health, safety, and environmental regulations, as well as international standards.
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to HSEW teams, coordinators, and site safety personnel.
* Oversee contractor and subcontractor HSEW performance, ensuring alignment with project safety requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust safety reporting systems, including KPIs, audits, and incident investigations.
* Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Promote a strong safety culture through training, awareness programs, and leadership engagement.
* Collaborate with project leadership teams to integrate HSEW into project planning and execution strategies.
* Manage site security requirements and oversee third\-party security service providers.
* Support the development of Project Execution Plans, including HSEW frameworks during engineering and mobilization phases.
* Engage with clients, stakeholders, and regulatory bodies on all HSEW\-related matters.


**About You**
* Minimum 15\+ years of HSE experience, with at least 5\+ years in a leadership/director role.
* Mandatory experience in high\-end luxury hospitality and residential projects in KSA.
* Strong background in construction, infrastructure, or mega\-project environments, preferably in remote locations.
* In\-depth knowledge of KSA HSE regulations, international standards (ISO 45001 / OHSAS 18001\), and best practices.
* Proven experience in developing and implementing corporate HSEW strategies and programs.
* Expertise in managing contractor safety performance and stakeholder coordination.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to present and report to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Safety Management Systems.
* Degree or Diploma in Health \& Safety, Environmental Science, or related field.
* Professional certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent) preferred.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Title: HSE Manager**
**About ENGIE**
 ENGIE Group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
   

  

****Key activities and competencies****
**Strategic:**
* Develop a strategy for effective project occupational HSE management, including objectives, targets, and KPIs in line with ENGIE Group / AMEA HSE KPIs \& objectives.
* Collaborate with other departments to ensure compliance with Engie Group Rules (GRs) and develop AMEA\-specific HSE Standards.
* Develop both proactive and reactive HSE key performance indicators.


**Operational:**
* Provide HSE leadership and coordination to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and reduce the frequency and severity of adverse HSE events.
* Ensure consistent implementation of Project Company Health, Safety, and Environmental Standards during construction and commissioning up to COD and Operations.
* Maintain the Project Risk Register (HSE) and update it periodically based on actual risks.
* Manage high\-risk activities, including equipment logistics and lifting operations.
* Promote open and transparent Health, Safety, and Environmental reporting from the Project Company and Contractor(s) to AMEA Country HSE.
* Develop training, induction, and onboarding programs for Project Co. and contractors.


**Organisational:**
* Support the development of Engie HSE tools, procedures, and practices.
* Organise and participate in HSE campaigns and ensure contractor participation.
* Coordinate the design and delivery of HSE reports, presentations, and training programs.
* Support the HSE prequalification of contractors or subcontractors and assist in vendor selection.
* Monitor and measure Owners Engineer and contractor HSE performance.
* Conduct regular audits and site inspections to ensure contractor compliance with Project Company policies and procedures.
* Organise internal site peer reviews with recognized HSE experts.
* Manage the selection of third\-party auditors, consultants, and HSE contractors/practitioners
* Identify trends in Health and Safety performance and implement initiatives for improvement.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and maintain appropriate measurement, recording, and reporting systems.
* Develop robust emergency procedures and conduct regular drills.
* Support the development of HSE O\&M (Operational procedures review and validation).
* Facilitate internal and external benchmarking in construction HSE issues.
* Communicate lessons learned from other projects received from ENGIE and other sources.
* Manage relations with external partners on health, safety, and environmental issues (local authorities, equipment manufacturers, contractors, suppliers, etc.).


**Planning \& Delivery of Work:**
* Ensure HSE onboarding for everyone on the project through the Contractor.
* Oversee the development of comprehensive training programs for the workforce by Contractor(s).
* Assess and record the competency of HSE critical workforce.
* Implement and review a strict Construction Safe System Of Work (Permit to Work).
* Implement and review a strict Commissioning Safe System Of Work (Permit to Work).


**Decision Making:**
* Assess the effectiveness of risk management across the fleet and recommend actions for continuous improvement.
* Review and approve Project accident and incident investigations.
* Ensure proper and swift incident investigation to be performed by EPC contractors, including incidents occurring within subcontracted activities
* Assist and advise in the implementation of improvement and mitigation actions following incident investigations, ensure actions are closed and that lessons learned are circulated.
* Ability to work autonomously, prioritizing tasks and activities in line with business objectives.
* Ability to demonstrate support for innovation and for organizational changes, critical thinking.
* Maintains high ethical standards.


**Working with others:**
* Develop strong partnerships with the Project Construction Director, Country HSE Manager, other asset HSE teams, partners and external consultants where necessary.
* Work in coordination with the AMEA HSE network to enhance HSE awareness and engagement.
* Manage, mentor and develop your direct / indirect report in line with our People Development Strategy.
* Ability to work within a team of members from varying cultural backgrounds as well as with counterparts of varying cultural backgrounds.
* Able to work in a multicultural environment and with multidisciplinary teams
* Strong leadership abilities to engage people proactively to work towards project Safety Culture.
* Presence and interpersonal credibility to represent the Project Company with key stakeholders, JV partners and external organisations, Government representatives, Local \& national agencies.


****Key relationships****
 Internal:
   

  

* Project Company Management team, Employees, Owner Engineering team, Contractors \& Subcontractors
* Head of HSE RGBU AMEA
* Engie Group HSE
* internal Stakeholders representatives \& visitors
* Lenders Engineer and other internal inspectors / auditors.
* Assigned Medical service Provider(s)
* International SOS agency (ENGIE)


 External:
   

  

* Partner’s Representatives
* External consultants
* Government Regulatory authorities, Environmental inspection agencies.
* Local security agencies, police, emergency medical organisations.
* Local Communities (indirect).
* Other external Stakeholders and relevant parties including NGO’s (indirect).


****Required Qualifications****
 Qualifications:
   

  

* Recognised Engineering or science qualification
* Internationally recognized Safety and Health qualification (NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent as a minimum).
* Accreditations preferred for Fire \& Risk management, Advanced First Aid, Confined Spaces, Emergency Response Rescue, Heavy Equipment inspection, scaffolding management.


 Experience:
   

  

* Minimum 15 years’ experience managing Health, Safety, Environment Projects as a Manager within the Power Generation Industry:
* Power generation technology including renewables (Solar project experience preferred)
* Water desalination and chemical treatment systems.
* Civil, mechanical and construction activities.
* Successful HSE track record within construction and commissioning of large\-scale Projects. (\>1 BUSD)
* Professional experience working in Remote Project locations in hardship environments.
* In depth understanding for implementing management systems such as ISO:45001 and ISO:14001\.
* Professional experience in managing HSE within a culturally diverse workforce and local population and other sensitive receptors (Stakeholder engagement \& management).
* Experience in Project Ethical standards, Welfare, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with strict Environmental sensitive receptors and cultural heritage Management.
* Experience in Safety Management of complex Logistical mobilization of equipment \& resources over long distances.
* Experience in Overall Project Risk Register and Risk Mitigation Management.
* Experience in management Project Emergency Response Planning, in particular medical emergencies.
* Understanding in the application of International Standards (NFPA, ISO, OSHAD, etc.) as needed.
* Professional H\&S experience for complex construction activities including heavy lifting operations.


 Knowledge and Skills:
   

  

* High Proficiency in English (verbal and written), Hindi / Urdu, Arabic desirable but not essential.
* High level of HSE technical knowledge and understanding of Process Safety Management.
* Excellent communication, training, and presentation skills.
* High level of data analysis skills and experience in audit, inspection, and report writing.
* MS Office \& Social Media applications
* Proficiency utilising Noise monitoring, Atmospheric Gas testing, and environmental monitoring devices.


 Business Unit: GBU Renewables \& Flexible Power
   

  

 Division: GEN International \- KSA
   

  

 Legal Entity: ENGIE Regional Headquarters LLC
   

  

 Professional Experience: Skilled ( \>3 experience \<15 years)
   

  

 Education Level: Bachelor's Degree
   

  

 Company Name: ENGIE Saudi Arabia

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2024, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11\.76 billion.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Role Purpose**




 Sika is embarking on the construction of a new plant and the consolidation of its existing sites in Qatar. We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead, coordinate, and oversee the full cycle of these strategic projects. The role requires strong leadership, technical knowledge of industrial construction, and proven project management experience to ensure timely, cost\-efficient, and safe delivery in line with Sika’s global standards.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Project Leadership \& Planning** 
	+ Lead the planning, design, and execution of the new plant construction and site consolidation projects.
	+ Develop and manage detailed project timelines, budgets, and resource plans.
	+ Coordinate with internal stakeholders (local, regional, and global teams) and external partners (consultants, contractors, suppliers).
* **Execution \& Supervision** 
	+ Oversee construction activities, ensuring compliance with design specifications, Sika standards, local regulations, and HSE requirements.
	+ Conduct regular site inspections and progress reviews, addressing deviations, risks, and bottlenecks.
	+ Manage contractors and subcontractors, ensuring quality, cost, and schedule commitments are met.
* **Stakeholder Management** 
	+ Act as the main point of contact for project stakeholders, including authorities, consultants, and vendors.
	+ Report regularly on progress, risks, and financials to senior management.
	+ Ensure alignment of project objectives with business needs and operational requirements.
* **Governance, Compliance \& Safety** 
	+ Ensure all construction and consolidation activities follow Qatar’s regulatory requirements, Sika’s internal standards, and best practices.
	+ Drive a strong culture of safety and sustainability throughout project execution.


**Qualifications**

**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of proven experience managing industrial construction projects, preferably in chemical, building materials, or manufacturing industries.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is an asset).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-million\-dollar projects within scope, budget, and timelines.
* Experience working in GCC/Qatar projects with knowledge of local regulations, standards, and permitting processes.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong command of English; Arabic is an advantage.


**Additional Information**

**Key Competencies**



* Strategic thinker with hands\-on execution capability.
* Strong negotiation and contractor management skills.
* Problem solver with risk management capabilities.
* Resilient, results\-driven, and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.



 We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

 The Client Project Manager is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for leading and directing concurrent client projects classified as standard or complex.

* Leads and directs concurrent standard or complex projects, often managing multiple projects in parallel within fast‑paced delivery environments.

* Ensures clear and concise communications to all stakeholders.

* Identifies opportunities and influences the sale by conducting a business conversation with the client, positioning organizational consulting and technical services offerings.
* Coordinates activities of the project teams through task delegation and resource assignment.
* Performs any other related task as required.

* Ability to manage customer satisfaction, commitment, and expectations to high service levels, and manage escalations effectively with a firm, solutions‑driven mindset.
* Excellent communication skills are essential; this role requires a confident, resilient communicator who can challenge constructively and defend delivery commitments when required.

* Passionate, high‑energy, self‑driven, and results‑oriented.
* Strong influencing ability whilst taking a collaborative approach.
* Competent in project change management.
