* Competitive Compensation \& Benefits that ensure our employees are rewarded for their dedication and performance
* A strong Commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion, fostering a culture that values every individual’s unique perspective

**Your day to day**
* Ensures all food is prepared fresh and is of the highest quality
* Ensure the correct preparation and presentation of dishes in accordance with menu cards and produced on a consistent basis.
* Strictly adheres to all recipes, methods and instructions from supervisor.
* Consistently checks temperatures in foods and follows proper procedures in regards to chilling, re\-heating, and holding food.
* Checks outlet upon arrival to determine status of outstanding safety, or equipment issues
* Checks outlet prior to leaving to ensure cleanliness, proper disposal/removal of food, and proper storing and labeling
* Responsible for accuracy in daily inventories and requisitions.
* Assist the Head Chef in controlling and analyzing on an on\-going basis, the following:
* Quality levels of production and presentation, including employee cafeteria.
* Guest Satisfaction.
* Merchandising and promotions.
* Operating, Payroll, Food costs according to budget.
* Sanitation, Cleanliness and Hygiene.
* Food photo sessions for all new menus – set standard.
* Maintenance of recipe cards for all menu items.
* Staff attendance, rosters
* Assist in production, preparation and presentation of all food items to ensure highest quality at all times.
* Supervise and control the kitchen to meet work requirements.
* Assist Head Chef with inspections of physical of kitchen areas including cold rooms and equipment.
* Assumes responsibilities of Head Chef in his absence.
* Assist in the preparation and testing of outlet and promotional menus following the guidelines: Requirements, competition, trends, recipes, potential cost, availability.
* Maintain and keep up to date training record.
* Ensure team members are informed about new procedures, special events in the hotel, daily functions and food cost and to received feedback.
* Ensure hygiene and sanitation, all precautions on Fire, Health and Safety are taken in the kitchen and that all employees are will trained in this aspect.
* Display good time management techniques with proper planning and control.
* Strives to continuously improve flow of production
* Check regularly perishable food items received for quantity and quality standards.
* Assist Head Chef in the planning \& ordering of food stock in accordance with the volume of business.
* Perform related duties and special projects as assigned.


**FINANCIAL RETURN**
* Assist the Head Chef in supervising the functioning of all Kitchen employees’ facilities and costs to ensure maximum Food \& Beverage departmental profit is achieved.
* Controls and decreases waste by maintaining logs to submit daily/weekly
* Observe and comply with the company’s requisition and purchase order system


**RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS**
* Comply with and ensure adherence to all of the hotel’s policies and procedures
* Comply with all occupational health and safety policies and procedures
* Attend all scheduled meetings
* Inform on a daily basis the Head Chef of all relevant information in operational matters including information, which does not require the Head Chef’s action.
* Liaise with F \& B Controls for food costing, ordering and supply.
* Liaise with departmental heads for co\-ordination of functions and activities.
* Coordinate with kitchen stewarding for proper sanitation, maintenance of equipment, cleaning of cold stores, supply of service dishes, during service hours.
* Maintain a good working relationship with all staff and colleagues throughout the hotel and sister properties.
* Maintain in good working order all hotel property.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude at all times


**PEOPLE**

* Recommend increments, promotion and transfer of chefs to Head Chef and under his guidance conduct such functions as employee orientation, coaching and supervision, if necessary, to ensure appropriate productivity.
* Assist Head Chef in conducting formal on\-the\-job training session for kitchen employees.
* Utilize coaching skills and demonstrate the development of other team members.


**GENERAL**
* Communicate effectively with all other departments
* Attend meetings, training sessions and any other required meeting or training session.
* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offering to meet and exceed client expectations.
* Ensure safe work practices are adopted at all time and report any OHS concerns immediately to your direct manager or HR Manager.
* Ensure consistency in quality of appearance and taste, and the best quality menus using the freshest ingredients.
* Effectively participate in the organization of ordering, cost controlling and wastage of food.
* Lead by example and ensure all procedures (HACCP, Health and Safety, and Food Safety Management) are maintained to the required standards to which training has been received, and are being followed by all kitchen members.
* Manage and deliver the production needs of the kitchen to the required standards.
* Manage time through effective planning of work, maintaining a high level of productivity.
* Achieve customer satisfaction rating of above expectations.
* Meet maximum creativity and understanding of food, by creating dishes and assisting with menu development.
* Assigned projects are completed within designated timeframes
* Reports, presentations and other administrative duties are consistently on a high standard; and free of errors and omissions.


**What We Need From You**
**PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS**
**Education**
* Formal Hospitality Management qualifications in Culinary Institute– desirable
* Completion and awarded Intermediate Food Hygiene Certification
* Completion and awarded HACCP Certification


**Experience**
* At least 5 years previous experience in a hotel or branded units
* Minimum 2 years in similar capacity
* Experience in a high cover International /Mediterranean cuisine
* Knowledge in preparation of all Pastry and bakery products and all culinary operations.
* Knowledge of volume production and ability to maintain the highest quality standards.


**Technical**
* Competent Word, Excel, PowerPoint and software packages
* Competent Oral and Written Communication Skills
* Ability to follow standards recipes and convert quantities mathematically
* Ability to taste all foods to assure correct preparation
* Knowledge of stock control, rotas and budgetary controls


**Personal Attributes**
* ‘Can do’ attitude and a high level of energy
* Professionally groomed
* Able to manage task simultaneously; and priorities
* Flexible and aware of the pressure points within the kitchen environment and adapt to each situation with maturity and calmness.
* Hands\-on attitude, leads by example
* Always goes the extra mile to ensure guests satisfaction.

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 31st May 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

 The air cargo industry is entering an accelerated phase of change and transformation. From digitalizing the end\-to\-end value chain, to fortifying a true e\-commerce experience, to the launch of digital freight marketplaces, and much more.
   

  

 As the world’s largest global air cargo carrier, Qatar Airways is leading this change. To support our vision, we are looking for talents – the bold, the imaginative and the change\-maker. All of who will support Qatar Airways Cargo’s position as a true leader in the air freight industry.
   

  

 If you want to make an impact, to grow your experience and to challenge your comfort zone, then join us at Qatar Airways Cargo and be part of our passionate team.
   

  

 As the business expands, we are pleased to announce an incredibly exciting opportunity to be part of Qatar Airways Cargo’s Global Sales team in Doha as a Global Key Account Manager.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the principal direct sales channel for QR Cargo’s most strategic and high\-value customers, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and expanding relationships with a select portfolio of major accounts on a global scale. Based at Head Office, this role is accountable for achieving revenue and volume targets, driving the delivery of strategic account objectives, and ensuring the highest levels of customer satisfaction and business retention. You will represent the full spectrum of company products and services, develop and execute comprehensive account strategies, and act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers. This position plays a critical role in identifying new business opportunities, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring the successful implementation of customer solutions across all regions.

* Drive customer loyalty and business retention through the application of advanced sales tools, such as customized incentive programs and value\-added services. Identify and capitalize on opportunities to grow account revenue and expand the partnership.
* Maintain accurate records of account activities, progress against objectives, and key performance indicators. Regularly review and report on account status, risks, and opportunities to senior management.
* Stay informed of industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments. Continuously seek opportunities to enhance account management practices and deliver greater value to both the customer and the organization.


**Be part of an extraordinary story**

 Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably with job\-related experience in sales and marketing
* Deep understanding of the airline cargo value chain, including operational, commercial and regulatory aspects

* Excellent formal presentation skills and ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences, both internally and externally
* High emotional intelligence (EQ) with a focus on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and ensuring high satisfaction and retention


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Head of Faculty of English**
**Compass International School Doha, Qatar**
 Compass was established in 2006 to provide a premium British education to both expatriate and local Qatari families. We have three campuses; Al Themaid and Madinat Khalifa educate students from Early Years through to Secondary whereas Gharaffa is a stand\-alone Primary campus for children aged 3\-11\. All campuses offer a bespoke British curriculum. Secondary students can select from a wide range of IGSEs, AS and A levels. Additionally, we offer the prestigious IB Diploma Programme in Years 12 and 13\. All three sites offer a warm, friendly learning environment with our students at the heart of everything we do. We are proud of our outstanding teachers and our community feel. As for Qatar, a sunny climate year\-round and an airport with fantastic global connections ensures the continued popularity of this destination for expats.
   

  

 Our school has Qatar National Schools Accreditation (QNSA) and is a member of the British Schools in the Middle East (BSME), COBIS and AoBSO.
   

  

 To learn more about our school, please visit our website.
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Faculty. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at Compass. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of faculty performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the faculty will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

**You will have the following essential attributes:**
* university degree in a relevant specialist subject
* teaching qualification (QTS, PGCE/PDGE)
* teaching experience in a UK and/or international context
* strong working knowledge of the English national curriculum as relevant to your subject


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum and preparing student at Al Themaid for external examinations at IGSCE. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Faculty, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**Benefits**
 Nord Anglia Education is the world's leading premium schools organisation. We are a fast\-paced and growing family of 80\+ international schools in China, Europe, the Middle East, South\-East Asia and The Americas, providing outstanding education to over 90,000 students from preschool to 18 years of age. Our schools are united by one philosophy\-we are ambitious for our students, our people, our community and family of schools. This means that we want every student to achieve more in our schools, than in any other schools in the world. We ensure this through personalised learning enhanced with bespoke global opportunities such as Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. We learn from the best and with the best.
   

  

 We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 We offer a professional working environment and an attractive remuneration \& benefits package.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in a rapidly growing country which is perhaps best known for successfully hosting the World Cup in 2022\. Qatar is a great place to be based for travel and enjoys a lovely climate most of the year.
   

  

**Experience / Qualifications Sought**
**Essential:**
* A university degree in English or a related subject
* A teaching qualification (QTS)
* At least 5 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum


**Desirable:**
* Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
* Master's degree, or other significant professional development
* Previous international experience


**Personal Qualities Sought:**
* Fluent English speaker
* Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
* Reliability, loyalty and commitment
* Personal confidence and presence
* Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do' approach
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
* Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
* Sense of humour and grace under pressure
* Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
* Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
* Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
* Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 The application should be submitted online via the Nord Anglia Education Careers page.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application, and the details of three professional references, one of which should be a School Principal.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 1st August 2025\.
   

  

 The closing date for applications is
 **30th June 2026\.**
**Selection process**
 Interviews will be conducted face to face or via Teams.
   

  

 Candidates are encouraged to apply early as the school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date.
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people are able to thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender or culture.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both Country of residence/birth and any Country of residence within the last 10 years.

The
 **Country Manager** 
 is responsible for leading and growing the assigned market unit by driving sales performance, ensuring operational excellence and safeguarding full compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements. The role combines commercial leadership with general management accountability, people leadership, and strong governance ownership.
   

  

**Main Responsabilities**
 Commercial \& Sales Leadership
   

  

* Own and deliver the market unit’s sales strategy, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop the sales organization to achieve and exceed commercial objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and strategic stakeholders.
* Monitor pipeline health, pricing discipline, forecasting accuracy, and deal governance.
* Drive market positioning, go‑to‑market initiatives, and competitive differentiation within the assigned market.


 General Management \& Business Operations
   

  

* Manage P\&L for the Market Unit.
* Translate corporate strategy into local execution plans and measurable outcomes.
* Oversee day‑to‑day operations, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and alignment with Elopak standards, global procedures and IT/systems.

 Compliance, Risk \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, industry standards, and internal policies.
* Establish and maintain strong internal controls across sales, finance, HR, and operations.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate business, financial, and operational risks.
* Ensure accurate reporting, documentation, and audit readiness at all times.
* Promote a strong culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance across the market unit.
* Establish, develop and maintain positive business relationships in the local society, including public affairs within industry and sustainability associations.


 People \& Culture Leadership
   

  

* Lead, inspire, and engage a diverse, high‑performing team across functions.
* Set clear objectives, conduct performance management, and support talent development and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive, ethical, and performance‑driven culture aligned with company values.
* Ensure compliance with employment practices, labor regulations, and internal HR policies.


 Stakeholder Management \& Reporting

* Provide regular, transparent reporting on sales performance, financial results, risks, and compliance status.
* Collaborate closely with finance, legal, HR, and compliance functions to ensure aligned execution.


 Sustainability partner GCC Market

* Support waste management and recycling understanding and own the action plan for increasing recyclability rates in the region.

* Support (and lead when required), sustainability related discussions, information flow, presenting Elopak’s program to commercial stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* University Degree within Economics / Marketing (Bachelor level) or equivalent.
* Proven experience in a senior sales leadership, business management, or general management role (Min. 10 years).
* Experience in System Sales.
* Strong understanding of compliance, risk management, Saudi legislation and Governmental affairs.
* English and Arabic are mandatory.


**Personal Skills**
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to balance commercial drive and risk awareness.
* Integrity, ethics, and compliance mindset.

data.jd_text:
**1\. Job Purpose** 




  





 To provide administrative support to the Board of Directors and associated committees. Execute streamlining of board communication and collaboration, overseeing logistics, documentation, feedback, planning, and compliance for enhanced governance and organizational success, providing comprehensive support to enhance board performance and uphold standards.
 



  





**2\. Position Accountability Description** 




**Board Operations Management** 




  




1. Formulate and maintain a comprehensive board operations manual to guide activities effectively, ensuring clarity and alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards. Incorporate regular staff input for continuous improvements and superior functionality, resulting in a more robust and user\-friendly manual.
2. Collaborate with executive leadership to meticulously draft, review, and finalize board meeting agendas and materials, incorporating feedback, fostering collaboration, and ensuring adherence to governance and compliance requirements.
3. Arrange logistical details for board meetings, meticulously overseeing scheduling, venue selection, catering arrangements, technology setup, and promptly resolving any unforeseen challenges.
4. Provide and distribute meeting materials to board members in advance, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, customization according to preferences, secure distribution channels, and thorough content coverage.
5. Support board affairs director to analyze board meetings to record precise minutes, capturing nuanced discussions, decisions, action items, key points, highlighting follow\-ups, and facilitating efficient dissemination and implementation of outcomes.
6. Distribute prepared action plans coming out of the board \& committees meetings to relevant parties and follow up on the implementation of action plans.



  





**Document and Information Management** 




  




1. Track an organized repository of board documents meticulously, ensuring systematic categorization, version control, security protocols, accessible data, confidentiality, and streamlined retrieval processes for enhanced operational efficiency.
2. Undertake board member onboarding processes strategically, offering tailored induction sessions, facilitating informed access to pertinent resources, enabling seamless integration, fostering relationships, aligning with strategic goals, and promoting engagement.
3. Contribute to and collect detailed feedback from directors to compile comprehensive reports, analyzing insights, trends, performance metrics, and areas for improvement, and presenting synthesized recommendations for concerned committee review and strategic decision\-making.
4. Analyze board member evaluations and self\-assessment processes, compiling results, identifying areas for improvement, and recommending development opportunities to enhance board performance, while tracking progress, providing personalized feedback, and ensuring alignment with the board's goals.



  





**Board Communication and Support** 




  




1. Serve as the primary point of contact for board \& committees inquiries, managing communications professionally, providing timely responses, clarifying information, addressing concerns skillfully, nurturing relationships, and upholding a positive board \& committees experience.
2. Support board affairs director to Aadvise Board and Committee members on tailored communications strategies, fostering effective interactions with internal and external stakeholders, enhancing transparency and alignment, fostering collaboration, and promoting a harmonious working environment for organizational success.
3. Establish and maintain effective communication channels between the board and senior management, ensuring key information flows smoothly and providing timely updates on organizational performance and strategic initiatives.



  





**Event Coordination** 




  




1. Coordinate board retreats and strategic planning sessions, including agenda development, facilitator selection, and the creation of supporting materials to drive productive discussions and outcomes.
2. Prepare a comprehensive annual calendar of board and committee activities, meetings, and events, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and timely notification to all board members, incorporating feedback, key deadlines, and strategic milestones for optimal planning.
3. Help to create and execute special board events, such as recognition ceremonies, award presentations, and networking opportunities, to foster camaraderie and appreciation among board members, coordinating guest speakers, thematic elements, and leveraging social media to highlight achievements.



  





**Governance and Compliance** 




  




1. Oversee the development and maintenance of a comprehensive board and committees members skills matrix, identifying gaps and recommending targeted recruitment to ensure a diverse and effective board, incorporating emerging competencies, succession planning needs, and strategic alignment with organizational goals.
2. Support the Chairman in conducting board evaluations, compiling performance metrics, and providing actionable insights and recommendations for enhancing board effectiveness by facilitating post\-evaluation discussions, addressing identified issues, clarifying roles, and setting clear improvement goals.
3. Ensure compliance with all governance policies and procedures, conducting regular reviews, recommending updates, and ensuring adherence to ethical standards and legal requirements, while integrating best practices, stakeholder feedback, and proactive risk management strategies for continuous improvement. Ensure all rules and bylaws are adhered to by the board \& committees members during meetings and in the implementation of their decisions.



  





**Innovation and Continuous Improvement** 




  




1. Continuously benchmark Board operations practices against industry standards, adopting improvements to enhance efficiency and governance effectiveness.
2. Implement and monitor process improvements by analyzing current Board operations practices, identifying inefficiencies, and applying best practices to streamline workflows.
3. Explore and adopt new technologies and tools that can improve Board operations, keeping the team at the forefront of innovation and efficiency.
4. Foster a high\-performance culture by striving for excellence and encouraging peers, contributing to the overall success and continuous improvement of the Board operations team.



  





**Team Collaboration and Continuous Learning** 




  




1. Work collaboratively with team members and DACO management by sharing knowledge, providing support, and actively participating in team activities to foster a positive and productive work environment.
2. Engage in continuous learning by seeking feedback, attending training sessions, and staying updated on industry trends to enhance personal skills and professional growth.



  





  





 3\. Minimum Job Requirements
 


* 
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of progressive experience in board management, corporate governance, compliance, legal or a related field.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Manage customer relationships during order execution, acting as their advocate within the organization and enhancing communication across service offerings.
* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

data.jd_text:
**This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Technical Project Manager Tether Wallet in India.**
 This role sits at the core of a fast\-moving global product where digital wallet features are shipped to millions of users worldwide. You will own the end\-to\-end coordination of feature delivery, ensuring everything from engineering development to legal, compliance, marketing, and support alignment happens seamlessly. Acting as the central orchestration point, you will translate complex dependencies into structured execution plans and keep releases moving forward without delays. The environment is highly cross\-functional, international, and execution\-driven, requiring strong ownership and clarity under pressure. **The Role:** 




 You’ll work closely with business users, technical teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders to manage projects from initiation through to delivery.  The IT Project Management function is still relatively new, so this is also an opportunity to contribute to how projects are managed across the organisation moving forward.
 



  





 This role suits someone pragmatic, organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects at different stages of delivery.

 • Preparing project updates and status reporting for leadership and stakeholders.
 



 • Helping introduce and mature project management best practices across the organisation.

 • 3–5 years of experience managing IT, technology, or digital projects.
 



 • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders across technical and non\-technical teams.
 



 • Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Good understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
 



 • Experience with project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or similar.
 



 • Comfortable working across both applications and infrastructure\-related projects.
 



 • Experience working with integrations, APIs, migrations, SaaS platforms, or digital transformation initiatives is beneficial.
 



 • Background within insurance, banking, telecoms, MSPs, or other regulated/service\-led environments would be advantageous.
 



 • PMP or similar certification is a plus.
 



 • Arabic fluency would be a ideal.
 



  





**What’s in It for You:** 




 • Opportunity to join a business actively investing in digital transformation

 • A chance to help shape and improve delivery processes within a growing PMO function

 • A collaborative environment with strong leadership support for improving project delivery

 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard.  Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

* Direct line of report Regional Projects Director
* Critique tender documentation / Pre\-Construction project handover documentation, identify project risks and opportunities with Project Leads
* Manages the expectations of project leadership and stakeholders throughout the project.

* Responsible for managing the execution of all project milestones/deliverables. Establish and monitor program and project controls KPI's.

* Actively manages, communicates and mitigates project risks and issues and escalates when necessary


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years work experience on construction projects / Minimum 3 years as a Project Manager
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects.
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent)
* Civil/ CSA experience

* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills

data.jd_text:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
Celeros Flow Technology, LLC For over 140 years our products have helped ensure the safe, reliable operations of key industries. With a passion for precision and partnership, Celeros Flow Technology continues this heritage of high performance and dependability, providing mission critical, sustainable flow control solutions for our customers around the globe.
   

  

 Celeros Flow Technology is looking for individuals with a voice and a vision. We embrace change, diversity and promote new ways of looking at old ideas. We seek talented professionals to join our world\-class team of innovators in a global, collaborative \& multi\-cultural environment, where you will be challenged, supported, and inspired to be extraordinary.
   

  

**General Summary**
 The Job Holder will be responsible for the sales and business development of the of assigned brands/ products/ services, to key Power \& Energy End Users, within Saudi Arabia and Bahrain:
   

  

* 
+ Assigned Products Valves: Copes\-Vulcan and M\&J Valves
+ Assigned Products Closures: GD Engineering
+ Assigned Territory KSA \& Bahrain


 The Job Holder will proactively interact with new and existing customers to expand the customer base, develop the customer relationship, troubleshoot the specific customer concerns or problems, generate leads and opportunities, all with the objective to achieve the specified sales and business development targets. The Job Holder will also prepare and present sales presentations, sales forecasts and action plans in order to maximise the market potential and will develop goals accordingly to achieve the specified sales and business development targets.
   

  

**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Sell and promote Celeros Flow Technology assigned aftermarket on spares, upgrades and service solutions in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain (End users, service contractors, engineering consultants) or via Local Agents / Distributors (where applicable).
* Where Local Agents / Distributors are necessary it will be required to ensure the appropriate procedures are followed and the required support is provided to facilitate the deal. When engaging with a new Local Agent / Distributor ensure the due diligence documents should be completed and submitted in a timely manner to the Legal Department for approval. Continue to manage and support the Local Agents / Distributors – provide technical and commercial support, provide training and guidance, make joint visits to key Customers as necessary, set KPI’s, monitor and evaluate performance, provide feedback / escalate as necessary through weekly meetings and quarterly reviews.
* Demonstrate strong expertise for assigned products and for the industry.
* Develop and expand relationships with existing and potential Customers and maintain close relationships with key Customers through driving spares price agreements with key accounts.
* Communicate regularly and consistently with existing and potential Customers to generate leads and opportunities and maximize aftermarket entitlement of the installed base.
* Appraise Customer’s current and future needs and advise on the appropriate Celeros Flow Technology products and services to meet their requirements and propose alternative solutions as necessary.
* Follow up with Customers to ensure Celeros Flow Technology products and services are meeting their requirements and expectations.
* Investigate and coordinate the resolution of complaints raised by Customers and troubleshoot their concerns.
* Interface with Customers and conduct on\-site meetings as necessary to understand requirements, to obtain order commitment, to finalise designs and to resolve concerns / complaints.
* Collaborate with other Regional Product Sales Managers, sharing information and business opportunities.
* Coordinate with Field Service Engineers to win Customer maintenance contracts where appropriate.
* Support Field Service Engineers and conduct joint site visits to facilitate work and training activities.
* Proactively react to Customers RFQ’s (request for quotation). secure the necessary internal approval to proceed with a quotation. Effectively communicates to the Customer the intention to provide a quotation, or not. Updates the CRM or equivalent tool accordingly.
* In close consultation with the Application Engineering Team and where necessary the Product Management Team, review and interpret Customer enquiries. Analyze the requirements in line with data sheets, specifications, P\&IDs, plans, and other project specific documents. Design, size and select suitable products as per the Customers requirements and support the Application Engineering Team to develop an appropriate proposal / quotation.
* For both the Company and the Customer coordinate the technical and commercial review of the quotation and assist with the negotiations for the same.
* Once quotation negotiations have concluded, prior to receiving the Customers PO, secure the necessary approval as per Company established approval matrix for all orders above Company defined threshold limit and for all orders that stipulate exceptional T\&C’s.
* Organise and drive the preparation of bids and contracts.
* Coordinate with the Finance / Accounts team and be aware of and problems with Supplier and Customer accounts.
* Coordinate and actively participate in the order hand over meeting with the Manufacturing Facility, Project Manager and Supply Chain Team. Provide clarification on any specific project requirements and on any technical or commercial queries.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, review the market potential for assigned products in the assigned territories and compile a strategy and action plan in order to maximize market potential and achieve targets. Continue to develop and recommend innovative ideas and tactics to increase market share and increase sales.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, evaluate and determine optimum route to market, including a pricing and marketing strategy and identify suitable partnership Companies to sell Celeros Flow Technology products and services.
* Execute agreed action plans to achieve targets for assigned products in the assigned territories.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the assigned region on a regular basis. Report any concerns and suggested solutions and any opportunities and suggested action plans to the Line Manager / Regional Director.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports (forecast, customer visit report, etc.) showing sales volume including potential sales, monitored against the budget, with action plans to address variations.
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations and technical presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Participate in trade shows, exhibitions and seminars either directly or in conjunction with Local Agents / Distributors.
* Represent the Company in a professional manner aligned to the Celeros Flow Technology Values and ensure all activities comply with both legal and ethical standards.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Thinks both creatively and commercially; has in\-depth engineering knowledge to identify technical risks, solve problems and provide solutions but also has in\-depth commercial knowledge to identify risks within contracts.
* Analyses and interprets common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Must be able to define the problem, assess the risks, and develop recommendations for action plans. Furthermore, must be able to execute the action plan, focus and guide others to accomplish the plan and drive change where necessary.
* Encourages others to seek opportunities for different and innovative approaches to addressing problems and opportunities; facilitates the implementation and acceptance of change within the workplace.
* Displays exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, even when handling multiple demands and has a proven track record of meeting high performance standards.
* Responds professionally to all inquiries and complaints and remains calm and composed when under pressure.
* Communicates effectively, effortlessly tailoring the approach to the audience and the level of technical competence.
* Possesses the ability to prepare and deliver both sales and technical presentations and to train and transfer technical knowledge to internal and external stakeholders.
* Clearly and succinctly conveying information and ideas to individuals and groups in a variety of situations; communicating in a focused and compelling way that drives others’ thoughts and actions. Engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
* Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance of ideas and plans; modifying one’s own behaviour to accommodate tasks, situations, and individuals involved.
* Exhibits confidence with negotiations and possesses the power to influence.
* Is well organized, structured and methodical.
* Is self\-motivated, works independently with little supervision, positively establishes relationships across multiple locations and copes well with working remotely from the team and other departments.
* Is an effective team player (committed, reliable, responsible, flexible, helpful, supportive, active listener / communicator).
* Communicates fluently (verbal and written) in English \- essential, in Arabic – advantageous
* Possesses a valid Driving Licence converted for use in the Middle East – essential


**Education \& Experience**
* Degree in an Engineering discipline (Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Production, Fluid Power Technology)
* Five to ten years’ experience in the oil \& gas / power \& energy market – essential
* Strong understanding of mid\-stream market segment, especially pipeline and tank farm sub\-segment along with Power and Water market. Contacts at Aramco, SABIC, SWCC, SEC plants and sites are desirable.
* A thorough understanding of valves and their related applications – specific knowledge of the slab and expanding gate Control and Bypass valve markets, competition, differentiators would be a distinct advantage.
* Strong exposure to pig launcher and receiver solutions, specifically closure doors is required
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft packages including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project.


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

* Required daily to stand, sit, walk, talk, hear, and see (specific close vision abilities are required to perform computer work)
* Required occasionally to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl
* Required daily to use hands and fingers and arms to reach (to operate a computer and telephone)
* Required occasionally to lift and/or move objects that are light to moderate
* Required occasionally to travel (usually by air or road so may be required to sit for extended periods)


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

* Ability to work with moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone, and printers, etc.)
* Ability to work in an open planned office / individual office
* Ability to sit at a computer terminal for extended periods
* Ability to sit in a car or on a plane for extended periods


**DISCLAIMER**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**CELEROS FLOW TECHNOLOGY VALUES**
 All Celeros divisions are committed to the effective use of the Celeros Values. It is important that all employees understand and utilize these values when performing the duties of his/her position.
   

  

**INTEGRITY:** 
 We work safely and respect our employees, business partners \& environment. We always lead by example.
   

  

**SPEED:** 
 In our mission to bring mission\-critical flow control equipment to the world, energy in our actions \& urgency.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITY:** 
 We stand behind our actions and deliver on our promises.
   

  

**PARTNERSHIP:** 
 We collaborate across our teams \& our customers to win together. We rely on each other to deliver the best outcome \& celebrate successes.
   

  

**EXCELLENCE:** 
 We are passionate about being the best at engineering, manufacturing \& maintaining mission\-critical equipment. We seek quality \& community improvement in every interaction.
   

  

**QUALITY**
 Quality encompasses all aspects of Celeros’ business, and every employee shares the responsibility to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to product, process and the quality system. All employees have an obligation to identify and record any such nonconformity, and through designed channels, initiate and recommend solutions.
   

  

**CELEROS Flow Technology is an equal opportunity employer.**

Our client is a landmark five\-star hotel in Manama and they are seeking a
 **Spa \& Health Club Manager** 
 (Director of Spa \& Wellness) to take charge of its upcoming
 **luxury spa project** 
 woth 1\.5 Million BD, while overseeing a fully renovated (Completed 2025\)
 **health and fitness facility** 
 . This is a unique opportunity to be part of something exceptional from the ground up—contributing directly to the
 **design, development, and launch** 
 of a spa experience that will redefine wellness in the region.
 



  





**The Opportunity: A New Luxury Spa Destination** 




 Planned Opening in 2026, this expansive wellness facility is currently in its second design phase, with construction scheduled for early next year. As the Spa \& Health Club Manager, you will:
 


* **Play a key role in shaping the design** 
 – your input will influence layouts, technical features, treatment flow, and guest experience.
* **Lead the pre\-opening and operational launch** 
 – from menu development to recruitment and branding.
* Oversee a facility that includes:
* 10–12 treatment rooms
* Private\-use Turkish hammam
* Salt inhalation room for yoga and therapy
* Hot and cold hydrotherapy pools, including a 12–13°C cold plunge
* Elegant, contemporary interiors designed to rival the region’s most prestigious spas



  





 The spa will operate as a
 **standalone wellness destination** 
 , separate from the hotel’s fitness club, and will cater to a sophisticated, wellness\-driven clientele of both hotel guests and local members.
 



  





 You’ll work alongside a strong supervisory team that handles daily operations—allowing you to focus on strategic leadership and spa development.
 



  





**Your Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Provide strategic and hands\-on leadership across both spa and health club operations
* Ensure excellence in guest service, treatment quality, and wellness standards
* Recruit, train, and inspire a team of 15–20 staff, in partnership with HR
* Collaborate with hotel leadership on financial performance, pricing, retail sales, and marketing
* Drive revenue, guest satisfaction, and brand positioning in the luxury wellness space
* Build a loyal base of external and in\-house guests through targeted promotions and digital presence (primarily Instagram)



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




 You’re a seasoned spa leader with the ambition to take on a major project. Your background likely includes:
 


* Experience as Spa Manager or Assistant Director of Spa in a luxury hotel, resort, or branded wellness facility
* Knowledge of Middle Eastern spa culture and guest expectations (experience in the region is a strong advantage)
* A blend of
 **operational know\-how** 
 ,
 **commercial acumen** 
 , and

 **performance\-based bonus**

* **Relocation allowance** 
 ,

 , and
 **annual flight home**
* **Comprehensive medical coverage**
* The opportunity to
 **shape a flagship spa project** 
 and grow your career within a leading international hotel brand

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Airport Design Manager will lead and manage all design activities for the airport project under the Project Management Consultant (PMC). The role ensures that designs are coordinated, compliant, and delivered on time, aligning with project objectives, budget, and international standards while integrating all disciplines effectively.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the overall design process across all disciplines, including civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and special airport systems.
* Knowledge for the implementation of IATA ADRM, GACA 139, IBC (also Saudi Codes and Regulations), and NFPA.
* Develop and implement design management plans, schedules, and deliverables tracking.
* Coordinate with design consultants to ensure timely submission and approval of design documents.
* Review and validate design deliverables to ensure compliance with project requirements, codes, and standards.
* Ensure proper integration and coordination between multidisciplinary design components.
* Identify design risks, clashes, and inconsistencies, and ensure timely resolution.
* Manage design changes and ensure proper documentation and approval processes are followed.
* Liaise with stakeholders, including clients, authorities, operators, and contractors, for design approvals.
* Support value engineering initiatives to optimize design efficiency, cost, and constructability.
* Lead design coordination meetings and provide technical direction to the project team.
* Informs themselves of the relevant Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures in place within Hill International, and ensures continued compliance with these requirements while employed by Hill.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Project Director or line manager.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Architecture (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum 15 years’ relevant experience in Airport/Aviation projects, including space utilization, concept design, IBC (also Saudi Codes and Regulations), GACA 139, NFPA, and IATA ADRM, and able to draft the scope of works and specifications.
* Thorough knowledge of airport landside and Passenger Terminal operations
* Effectively uncover client needs and provide compelling solutions.
* Thoroughly perform site inventories.
* Stakeholder management and consultation
